concepts.title: Personal directory favorites
concepts.summary: Runtime stores independent ordered favorites/revisions per authenticated namespace/endpoint/user. Env App/Desktop supply metadata to published Floe pickers and menus; existing filesystem navigation alone validates/selects paths. Favorites neither grant authority nor duplicate navigation.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Persistence and authentication
The Runtime opens apps/filesystem/directory-favorites.sqlite through sqliteutil before service readiness and closes it with Code App. Schema v1 is initialized transactionally; existing tables, objects and records are verified and unsupported or future schemas fail before a writable open.

There is no ten-item cap, automatic deletion, move tracking, grouping or custom naming.

## Client ownership and interaction
One in-memory client per authenticated environment supplies every mounted entry.

Initial load failure offers retry; refresh failure retains displayed paths.

No separate title card, second path line or persistent favorite star occupies the sidebar.

Files composes Home, Computer and favorites into one Quick access list, deduplicated by absolute path with authoritative root labels and permissions preserved. All entries share filtering and scrolling; roots are not pinned separately. Short lists use their natural height, capped at the smaller of 16rem and 45% of the sidebar body. The directory tree owns a separate viewport. Filtering appears above five entries, matches labels or full paths, holds the viewport height while active, and restores the previous list scroll on clear. Refresh retains rows, focus and the query. Arrow/Home/End navigation reveals only the local target, including in scaled Workbench windows. Menu invocation retains the captured directory and published focus ownership.

Quick access marks only the exact active destination, never its containing root. The existing navigator supplies pending intent: selection and busy semantics update immediately; the progress icon appears only after 150ms of uninterrupted waiting to avoid fast-refresh flicker. Current-page semantics identify only the displayed path. Hover is weaker than selection; a leading marker distinguishes selection from focus. Selection never changes font weight, size or text geometry. Filtering never promotes another row to active.

The entire 32px-high shortcut row is a native navigation button, including padding and permission badges, except for the separate trailing 32px menu button. No dead gaps or overlapping actions divide these targets; pointer, keyboard and touch retain the same navigation/menu ownership.

Published Sidebar owns the outer width; the Files/Git body fits its content box without a second fixed width or outer scroll owner.

Flower exposes favorites inside its directory picker. Conversation transcript and thread-list menus do not mutate directory favorites; their directory actions follow [working directory navigation](flower-working-directory-navigation.md).

## Compatibility
Runtime compatibility epoch 69 requires this exact authenticated resource and Desktop route allowlist. Floret APIs, domain schema, conversation lifecycle, file-operation authorization and Runtime Service protocol version remain unchanged.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Drag-region synchronization
Desktop projects iframe-relative native drag regions. A settled snapshot must not schedule another frame by rebuilding itself; native pointer/geometry ownership remains upstream.

## Global bands
Ordinary windows use 1000–1099; expanded Flower 2000; its context previews 2100–2199; plugin Panel 3000 and plugin context menu 3100; product modals 4000; command palette 5000. Local menus, tooltips and recovery UI stay within their surface's global band.

## Dialog placement
Mobile plugin/tools navigation belongs to Shell content, not a global Launcher. Backdrop clicks close only the Dialog without reaching Activity beneath it; titlebar controls remain no-drag.

## Visible viewport boundaries
Published Floe owns visible viewport/safe areas, Safari fixed-origin conversion and projected-surface intersection. Do not bypass it with fixed positions, uncapped viewport heights or transforms. Temporary constraints preserve preferred size.

Upstream elastic dragging resists boundary overflow, retains a reachable header and returns the window inside safe bounds on release/interruption. Dragging a maximized header restores preferred size at the grab point and continues the gesture; controls, double-click and mounted body remain independent. Redeven supplies safe-area insets and persists only settled geometry.

## Movable window order
A Shell-lifetime provider registers stable IDs, retains multiply registered IDs until all owners unregister, and assigns bounded MRU order within each window band. Minimized Debug Console is a base-band launcher, not an open window.

## Flower dismissal
Expanded Flower sits above ordinary windows; owned previews sit above Flower and below plugin Panels. Dismissal never restores composer focus, which would expand it again. Host pointer/focus and trusted plugin bridge activation/focus/action events collapse Flower without consuming destination interaction, including cross-origin iframe interaction.

Published Floe keeps resize handles on the outer geometry surface, outside rounded content clipping. All eight handles remain pointer-reachable; compact and maximized windows expose none.

sections.body: This contract governs cross-surface Env App stacking and the Activity-versus-Workbench Dialog boundary. Container projections follow that same owner instead of clearing their inventory on connection changes.

Activating a Codespaces view refreshes its shared inventory; no new polling or connection recovery loop is introduced.

A stale application is resolved through current inventory before launch.

Cached restoration never installs components, requests permissions, launches processes, or starts lifecycle operations.

concepts.summary: Redeven owns source identity, authorization and preview modes; published renderers own layout and parsing. Each page has one asynchronous owner, stale work is fenced and failures remain local/retryable. HTML stays isolated, rich formats retain original bytes and unselected widgets gain no input authority.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Viewport and formats
### Viewport
[Floating layers](env-app-floating-layer-order.md) owns placement/clamps. Keep title/close/toolbar reachable with local scrolling. Fit uses local CSS pixels excluding padding/scrollbars, independent of Workbench transforms. Attachments keep native PDF controls/contained images/shrinkable containers.

Lazy Floe PDF owns layers/scoped CSS. One PDF/PPTX renderer/page; identity fences callbacks/stale work. Cancellation neutral, faults local/retryable.

### Office/delimited
Shared task/attachment adapters serve both hosts. Attachments retain native image/PDF/text; Env App file actions/Monaco/selected-Workbench wheel. Never pass legacy XLS/DOC/PPT to OOXML.

XLSX/CSV/TSV lazily consume exact unmodified @silurus/ooxml@0.89.7 XLSX with copied original bytes, no flattening. XlsxWorkbook.load, visible metadata/getWorksheet/XlsxSheetViewer.fromWorkbook/activation own rendering. Read sheet before activation to expose parse errors; select every visible sheet,skip hidden. Engine owns styles/merges/cached formulas/comments. Remove ExcelJS/200-row50-column caps everywhere.

One toolbar:sheet,optional value,search,zoom,info. Explicit/Ctrl-Cmd+F search returns focus on close. Published SurfaceFloatingLayer/useOverlayMask isolates cell/fidelity panels on narrow screens; Escape closes before parent. CSV/TSV keeps table/source/encoding and literal zero/long-ID/formula-like cells. Editing/truncation forces source; encoding affects table only.

Limits20MiB input/100000rows/1000000cells/64MiB UTF8/128MiB JSON. Disable Google Fonts/hyperlinks; comments XLSX-only. Engine resize ignores host transforms. Replacement/unmount fences work,destroys viewer before workbook. Parse/render/search errors stay Retry; resolved Promise cannot erase failure. Distinguish unsupported legacy/supported failure.

DOCX keeps docx-preview with off-DOM identity-checked commit. Floe PPTX owns pages/navigation/incomplete-external warning. All rich previews20MiB/local Retry; originals unchanged. Original-author releases only,no fork/vendor/patch/model rewrite/fallback. XLSX indentation/views/malformed fidelity may differ from Office; DOCX/PPTX migration needs upstream fixes/Word math-layout evidence. Lazy assets include licenses; production admits only hashed graph-router/XLSX WASM matching installed package bytes. Unknown/altered assets reject. Build size≠installer size.

### HTML/Markdown
[HTML](#html) owns page-first/edit/bounds/isolation/incomplete rejection. [Diagrams](markdown-diagrams.md) use Floe/Pele with theme and identity-fenced cleanup. Contents defaults closed in right-drawer Dialog,retaining width/nodes/scroll; heading scroll closes it. File change resets,headingless disables; main sidebar remains.

Floe roles: headings/links interaction-info; lower headings/quotes tip; emphasis note; code ink. Dark headings keep hue/lightness floor; tables/metadata subtle, GFM alerts semantic. Text/inset titles>=4.5:1 across presets/materials/windows. Preserve underline/focus/selection/forced colors; theme never changes geometry/DOM/selection/focus/scroll.

## HTML
### Page rendering
Files ending in `.html`, `.htm`, or `.xhtml`, regardless of case, open as rendered pages in floating windows, mobile previews, Workbench, and attachment snapshot previews.

It renders an opaque `allow-scripts`, no-referrer iframe; it never inserts file HTML into the trusted shell or navigates to an authenticated file endpoint.

The current Activity file preview and Workbench same-file reuse rules still own placement.

### Placement and interaction
The page fills the reading area and scrolls internally. An unselected Workbench iframe is inert and cannot intercept pointer, keyboard, or wheel input. Unrelated shell updates preserve the live document. Floe owns revision-fenced HTML presentation: private document-load completion plus rendering opportunities, not arbitrary application idle. Reading and rendering retain one stable localized pending surface; short feedback is delayed without delaying content. Loaded tab switches never reenter loading. Source replacement fences earlier messages, pending callbacks and link errors. Inactive HTML pauses native media and never autoplays on return; scripts/canvases are not forcibly suspended. Keep the opaque sandbox/CSP and file-size limits. Attachments render snapshot HTML/HTM/XHTML with the same 2 MiB bound and no editor permission.

### Source editing and snapshots
Edit opens the existing HTML source editor only when write permission permits. Attachment snapshots remain read-only and show the attached bytes rather than re-reading the live file.

## PPTX
PPTX uses the lazy published `@floegence/floe-webapp-core/pptx` entrypoint. Opening another file type must not load the PPTX engine.

Preview opens directly to the slides without a generic PowerPoint compatibility notice or an empty notice bar. Document-specific guidance appears only when external resources are disabled or some content cannot be rendered.

The renderer's original licenses, ECMA geometry notice, bundled dependency notices, and MPL corresponding source are verified and retained in the distributed third-party notice.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
[Window actions](file-preview-window-actions.md#window-actions) owns drafts/actions/dismissal. Preserve unselected-widget wheel ownership,permission/editability/native attachment PDF.

[Window actions](file-preview-window-actions.md#window-actions) owns shared file actions and draft dismissal. Synthetic clicks, forged messages, sibling iframes, and retired documents cannot invoke its host handler. User-activated file navigation does not authorize automatic loading of neighboring assets or add a separate editor lifecycle.

The [preview viewport contract](#viewport-and-formats) owns shared fit, controls, and local coordinate policy. This surface must not grant unselected widgets local wheel authority or change file permissions or editability.

sections.body:
## Window actions
Activity consumes Floe titleContent/WindowTabs/headerActions. One document has ordinary title;>=2 replace title only with scrollable closable tabs. Selection never drags/maximizes. Blank header/grip/inactive feedback/separators move window; real controls own pointer,including portaled actions via physical titlebar ownership. Labels do not select text.

Sorting retains opaque face/quiet shadow under pointer,shifts neighbors/settles without insertion bar/external border. Commit order on release,cancel restores; reduced motion skips settling. Alt+Shift+Left/Right sorts;Escape cancels before dismissal. Preserve selection/panel DOM/live iframes. Arrow/Home/End/Delete stay local;focus visible,long names truncate/full path tooltip. Header retains Ask Flower/More/fixed controls. More owns Copy path/Edit/Save/Discard/Download with existing permission/selection/feedback;no extra path row.

One retained controller/panel per normalized path serves all filesystem entries; repeated open selects without reread/discard. Switching preserves draft/nodes/position/mode and pauses inactive native media. Published Floe RetainedPanel keeps each inactive panel laid out at the current viewport size with visibility hidden, inert and ARIA-hidden; never use hidden/display:none for tab activation. Panel DOM order remains independent of tab order. Independent actions/load/errors/Retry per tab. Inactive close preserves active;active close selects adjacent;last closes window. Window close confirms all unsaved together;cancel preserves all. Saving blocks discard until settled.

Flower attachments use source-identity tabs through same header in both hosts,independent loaders/retry/cancel/object-URL retirement;repeat selects existing source. Snapshot inspectors,Workbench widgets and modal conversation-file back navigation retain separate ownership. Workbench starts beneath header except sync notices;tooltip/Copy exposes path,keyboard/Escape/Tab cannot trigger canvas or shell focus reclaim. FilePreviewActions is sole availability/feedback owner and download builder retains draft mapping. Writable PDFs use Edit;PDF.js saves Unicode,NeedAppearances for unsupported fonts,no replacement-font embed. Product Downloads owns all downloads,including child previews ([lifetime](../ai/flower-task-files.md#downloads-and-panel)). Live navigation opens current objects;historical snapshots retain bytes;failed targets offer Retry/Open parent.

## Preview retirement
Cancel/fence reads immediately on accepted close; no new edits/retries/probes. Retain document/title/existing resources through Floe exit,release on unmount;switching tabs never closes controller. Reopen reverses same presence owner;old release cannot clear current/retained preview. Store constant-size presentation token/references only,no copied lifecycle/timer/blank iframe/extra read or brightness rebound. Disposal always cleans/fences late responses.

## Files window retirement
Explicit close clears browser request/restores focus immediately while host memoizes last title/key/live browser through shared inert exit. Same owner cancels exit on reopen;no old completion/detached browser/timeout survives. Subsequent actions need not await motion. A1000-entry/five-cycle fixture checks synchronous close,opener focus,underlying action and<50ms frame intervals.

## Absolute paths and runtime authority
Released Floe DirectoryPicker/DirectoryInput/file pickers own navigation/validity/request lifetime. Redeven supplies connection, authoritative path context, i18n/form state. [Filesystem policy](../security/permission-policy-and-filesystem-scope.md) reauthorizes operations; Home/Root/context never invent grants.

## Navigation state and failures
Each picker owns directory/entries/input/hidden switch/validity. Fence stale success/failure by current intent; validation is no later authorization. Files uses released parsePickerPath/formatPickerPath without Home-prefixing absolute paths. Real viewports declare Workbench local-scroll; host/Floe retain modal/focus/keyboard.

## Live language changes
Translate Home/Root in place without replacing drafts/selection or reloading authority; Desktop/Env App share the adapter.

## Product presentations
A failed Files navigation retains its last readable listing and one dismissible notice:selectable full path, copy, recovery actions. Without a readable listing use a bounded recovery card. Paths wrap/controls reflow inside scaled/narrow views. Link input to this notice by ID; syntax/cancellation retain own explanation. Editing clears stale invalid-input state, not unresolved navigation. Retry keeps focus/geometry through pending/repeated failure.

Existing browse/cache owner shows only visited target's snapshot while verifying. Uncached targets preserve readable listing with separate pending intent. Current clicks do not reload; pending duplicates share a request. Unverified cached destinations still verify/commit. Superseded reads release queue immediately and cannot alter content/persistence/recovery. Manual/hidden-path changes verify first.

Reveal each changed tree destination once per visible container; revalidation cannot repeat scrollIntoView or undo user scroll. Pointer navigation keeps row anchor; selection typography/geometry never transitions.

## Creating a child directory
Released picker owns New folder and nonmodal anchored popup:parent, name, actions, focus, Enter/Escape, pending/stale-request handling. No extra backdrop/resize. Escape/Cancel/outside idle closes popup only. Failure retains name/local error. One authenticated callback serves Flower, DirectoryInput/Env adapters. Names are one child, not traversal/nested paths. Success refreshes parent; enter/confirm remain explicit. Canceling picker preserves draft and cannot undo submitted work.

Env App uses nonrecursive filesystem RPC/invalidation; Desktop exact POST /_redeven_proxy/api/fs/mkdir. Both share filesystem/scope/Git mutation owners. Require session write, strict fields, existing parent and preserve existing entries. No recursive creation, synthetic list or automatic retry. Unknown effects require inspection. All ten locales translate errors. Compatibility epoch 70 requires the Desktop resource; older peers upgrade. Gateway/Floret/schema unchanged.

## Shared directory favorites
[Favorites](directory-favorites.md) owns scoped persistence/refresh/failures; shortcut views cannot confirm an old selection.

frontmatter.title: Flower Activity companion and contextual Ask Flower placement

concepts.summary: One retained Flower surface moves between authorized Activity and Workbench hosts. Published Floe owns companion geometry and presence; product adapters supply safe-area measurements and focus handoffs. Contextual Ask Flower adapts the published Floe `PromptCard`; Floe owns its complete layout, motion and viewport behavior. Placement creates neither another stream nor a second execution or editor owner.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Companion
### Companion ownership
Published `BottomBarCompanion` owns geometry, viewport/safe-area clamps, motion, outside dismissal, Escape and mount handling. Its Portal uses the explicit Activity overlay host, never `document.body`. The collapsed field is centered; bounded detail grows upward without changing body geometry. Running work cannot prevent collapse or destination interaction.

### Activity Terminal footer
Desktop Activity Terminal supplies a 24-pixel anchor in its 28-pixel footer, centered in the terminal column with a shrinkable 360-pixel maximum width. Workbench/mobile terminals supply none. Terminal supplies its reactive background/foreground alongside the anchor. Only the collapsed footer entry uses that palette: a restrained tinted surface, visible border and monochrome Flower icon. Expanded Flower keeps the shell theme; palette changes never replace its editor. Placement does not create another Flower instance, alter transport or route Flower input through the terminal.

### Stable Flower placement
After first access readiness, one retained `EnvAIPage`/`FlowerSurface` moves among explicit hosts. Visibility drives `hidden`, `aria-hidden` and `inert` together. Available unfiltered Workbench placement survives deselection; canvas selection governs input/focus only. [Settings](flower-setup-and-settings.md#retained-panels) own retained panels/forms.

### Contextual Ask Flower
New companion conversations may capture the desktop Activity origin using its read-only page reader. [Turn launcher](flower-turn-launcher.md#submission) owns sending/context actions.

### Presence and summary
[Presence](flower-companion-presence.md#presence) owns collapsed priority, live tails, completion feedback, composer precedence and workspace observation.

### Dismissal, focus, and reads
Outside capture includes shell, anchor and classified Flower-owned Portals. Trusted cross-origin plugin bridge events join host pointer/focus dismissal without consuming the destination. Shared SSE summaries are activity-only; initial/reconnect read baselines and later read envelopes are scoped to the same `UserPublicID`.

A floating window's geometry controls inherit ownership only from its direct published surface. Flower preview resize handles retain the companion; unrelated windows still dismiss it.

## Contextual window
### Shared input card
Desktop environment cards and every Env App contextual entry use the published `PromptCard` through the shared launcher. This is a compact input surface, not a conversation window: no `FloatingWindow`, fixed conversation height, draggable title bar, resize handles or maximize controls. The 384-pixel maximum width fits the visible viewport; height follows actual notes, the bounded reference strip, editor and explicit errors. The frameless editor and toolbar share one input surface without a divider. The editor uses the clean opaque Floe floating plane without a muted ink wash; neutral elevation supports the active input surface without a visible border in ordinary themes; accessibility contrast modes retain a boundary. Context and attachments precede the editor, followed by a compact toolbar with a plus attachment action, model choice and Send; text grows naturally within a bounded editor scroll area. File selection, paste and drop update the same editable intent immediately. Model discovery starts after paint through the existing model read resource, without delaying focus. The model name is the primary toolbar label, never a reasoning-level shorthand. There is no generated opening question, reply hint or input placeholder. Only actual intent notes add guidance. Opening focuses the real insertion caret immediately; completing model/file selection returns to the existing insertion point. The model dropdown uses published Select grouping and search, with the same provider brand, full model name and availability content as the Flower conversation picker. Provider groups distinguish identical model names while stable IDs remain the submitted identity. The selected model applies only to this request. The shared attachment controller validates and stages the captured files once; unknown admission retains the exact prepared model, attachment IDs and request identity for explicit retry.

### Host boundary and motion
Reference and attachment chips opt into the published `data-floe-prompt-reference` surface contract. Their opaque inset-well fill separates them from the clean floating-plane editor in light and dark themes without a drawn border, glow or additional shadow; the host retains content and actions.

The host measures the visible Shell header's client-space bottom edge and the Desktop titlebar safe area. Published `PromptCard` places beside the supplied point, flips upward when necessary and clamps to published Floe `observeViewport` bounds, including soft keyboard occlusion and CSS zoom. File and Git menus retain their original client-space point through dismissal and asynchronous detail preparation. Preview actions retain their own control/menu anchor. Other control and keyboard entries capture the initiating element through published `capturePromptCardAnchor` before focus moves; only programmatic openings without a source use the upper central content area. Position uses layout size, never animated bounds.

Published `PromptCard` uses shared `createFloatingPresence` for mounting, exit completion and reversal. Its 280ms entrance and 140ms exit use a twelve/six-pixel origin-based lift with restrained scale; clamped placement keeps its direction and reduced motion settles immediately. The shared presence owner commits the initial style once before opening, including when the host dispatches inside an animation frame; input remains ready in the opening task. The product supplies no alternate motion recipe. Exiting content retains the last intent, anchor and draft, becomes inert immediately and unmounts after the transition. Reversing an unfinished close for the same intent preserves editor and request identity.

### Interaction continuity
Opening focuses the editor unless the caller disables autofocus. Escape and Close restore the initiating control; outside pointer dismissal leaves destination interaction intact. IME composition and nested previews retain their Escape ownership. Related context previews and their direct geometry controls count as inside; unrelated windows remain outside. Sending paints a local busy acknowledgement before invoking host admission, and blocks duplicate submission and dismissal. References are inert during this handoff. Existing exact-request retry, unknown admission, reference removal, localization and panel-placement footer contracts remain with the shared launcher.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
The Workbench Flower widget retains its existing window, canvas, and focus contracts while contributing only a placement host for the Env App-owned Flower product.

The companion never auto-expands for completion, failure, approval, or user input. Showing an available, unfiltered Workbench Flower widget moves the retained product tree into that widget without starting a second list load or live stream, and later canvas deselection does not move it away.

Redeven owns Ask Flower identity, localized content, reference actions and request admission. Published Floe owns the complete reusable input card, focus, visible viewport geometry and presence. The adapter explicitly selects viewport portal scope so related Activity and Workbench previews share one interaction; constrained scrolling uses the host body ownership attributes. The card adds no window management or durable state. These constraints apply to the contextual launcher, not the main Flower surface or other floating windows.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Content and identity
Permanent folding gutter aligns prose/activity/progress/Goal before grouping. Details align with summary; tool/thinking metadata follows text with compact gap/full-row activation. Chevrons derive right/down solely from aria-expanded, including initially open screenshots.

Identity=thread/run/turn/canonical item. [Sequences](flower-tool-sequences.md) groups tools/thinking; individual details stay accessible. Collapsed fields preserve intent/result shape without hidden payload. Disclosure reads selected values:16KiB chunks/128KiB windows with selection pins. Close/hide/navigation cancels. Markdown keeps exact UTF-8/whitespace, yields between batches, and retains complete selected working set rather than fixed preview.

Thread Query:/Thread Read: remain technical labels with model intent in user language; [queries](../ai/flower-thread-queries.md) owns privacy/limits/failures. Web search uses one localized visible/accessibility title; details show actual per-call results/errors, including URL-only sources, without repeated query/URL/pattern/status.

Registered/hosted/source/MCP/unknown tools share compact glyphs/leading edge with prose/progress. Composer/status shares native scrollbar gutter. Existing resize observer reads only inline-size changes; existing layout scheduler publishes changed geometry. Row growth adds no width reads/observers/schedulers; embedded hosts retain ownership. Collapsed titles describe intent, never supply input/authority. Computer tools omit absent-observation filler but retain typed failures, uncertainty, blank pages and unavailable targets.

Authorized Activity source rows preserve exact host-authored text without path guessing; Floret v7.105.0 retains credential protection. Redacted/invalid_utf8_replaced/truncated facts have separate localized notices. Historical altered content is not reconstructed. Computer completed_reads describes requested scope independently of current snapshot authority; context reset and failed operation index stay visible in details. Structured result rows retain validated invalidation scope/event/frame, interrupted-wait measurements, and completed read identities; these facts do not authorize retries or establish application readiness.

## Observation interruptions
TARGET_OBSERVATION_UNAVAILABLE keeps canonical error/completed actions, but visible/accessibility copy says page read unavailable, distinguishing confirmed effects. Unknown effects/user decisions retain attention. Keyboard technical disclosure keeps original message/code. Published ActivityError.Code and bounded computer_observation=unavailable chips retain category without hidden-body reads. Exclude these interruptions from group/turn failure counts; confirmed time/operation budget exhaustion uses neutral completed-work-retained copy with canonical diagnostics. Permission/unknown-effect failures retain attention; other errors stay failures. Never infer old records from English, rewrite history, mark recovered from unrelated success or auto-retry.

## Viewport/input
One controller owns position; layout/focus/motion/growth cannot resume paused reading. [Sequence geometry](flower-tool-sequences.md#geometry-and-input) owns native nested scroll/inert controls; [SubAgents](flower-subagent-detail.md#task-presentation) owns child viewport.

Prose continuously approaches actual bottom; chunks retarget without restart. One line settles≈160ms with fractional positions/no overshoot. Share one geometry frame; motion-only frames reuse measurements and skip history scans until settled scroll. No idle polling/delayed output. Native input/selection pauses immediately; clearing selection does not resume. Initial positioning/navigation/resize/shrink are immediate. Explicit latest arrives220ms; automatic folds follow real content without trailing space/competing scroll. Exclude paused insertion room from latest distance. Reduced motion skips; hide/rebind/dispose cancels.

## Thinking and motion
Canonical first/last chunk receipts survive hydration/reconnect/restart/Fork. Continuation reopens interval, last chunk ends it. Tooltip distinguishes receipt vs compute; show<1ms/localized Not recorded, never infer neighbors/totals. Legacy observations remain memory-only.

Live petals fill clockwise then center, hold/fade2.4s. Sealed/canceled/disconnected static; CSS handles theme/reduced-motion/high-contrast/forced colors without lifecycle. Disclosure uses one reversible Web Animation,180ms open/140ms close, stale completions ignored. [Sequence handoff](flower-tool-sequences.md#disclosure-and-bodies) owns260ms geometry/crossfade/stationary prose.

Fresh tool/argument/thinking titles reveal once168–360ms,<=32 width-adapted steps; full text/geometry/accessibility/actions exist immediately. After sequence placement, make viewport room220ms before reveal; growth retargets without extending deadline. Scroll interrupts, paused reading remains; reduced motion skips. Delivery/results/controls never wait. Independent arrivals/shimmer preserve typography.

Accepted receipt/selection provenance gates execution arrivals. History/body restore/queued reads consume claims and settle statically; post-ready live snapshots/deltas qualify. Two visible receipts retain only restore revision/live flag, no copy/scheduler/timer/row observer. Claims exclude navigation/reconnect/hidden disclosure/>450ms delayed mounts; observe closure before lazy mount and survive preview promotion/remount/replacement/completion. Final snapshots may reveal new tools from previously active execution.

Auto-fold awaits admitted title motion then reading protection. New prose awaits sequence close; manual actions/delivery immediate. Title node survives trigger change, call identity transfers remaining time. Failure/approval immediate. Navigation/dispose/hide/reduced motion clears clipping; no character timers/per-frame reactive state/durable animation facts.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Approval presentation
### Reading and layout
Single/multiple approvals share one flat list. Rows pair safe operation labels with independent Reject/Allow once capsules and actual risk/targets/reasons. After input advances to approval, focus the first enabled decision or Stop.

### Canonical decisions and drafts
Primary requested approvals remain visible when `can_approve=false`, adapters cannot mutate, thread is read-only or detail is pending. Disable every decision with canonical/read-only reason. Local handoff, consumed sets, generations or busy reducers cannot own visibility.

Result content loss and child attention do not themselves create parent confirmation controls. The UI shows canonical tool Activity and actual input/approval requests; only real model-requested observation produces verification activity. Previously saved requests remain visible and answerable.

### Safe presentation
One pure presenter owns trusted operation/title/description/command/target/risk fields. Localized fallbacks are independent strings, never parsed from translated sentences; internal names/encoding prefixes remain hidden.

## Input and context
### Answering questions
Ask User keeps explicit choice-versus-custom draft identity per question. Secret answers use a password field and remain only in the volatile draft coordinator until canonical resolution or cancellation.

Unaccepted or cancelled input does not create a user receipt.

### Approving actions
The [Flower approval surface](#approval-presentation) owns the approval list, bounded layout, disclosure, focus, exact batch membership, and presentation contract. It shares the interaction submission guard and canonical reconciliation boundary described above.

### Context and recovery
Runtime restart recovery is quiet unless content cannot be recovered, in which case the affected row offers a nonblocking retry. All shipped locales provide the same distinction; keyboard users can focus the circle and dismiss its details with Escape.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
[Flower interactions and context state](#input-and-context) owns the shared input/approval/chat priority and interaction submission guard. This presentation cannot grant permission, infer risk from command names, settle interactions locally, or change the typed Respond API.

The decision surface owns drafts, disabled reasons, focus, and row-local commands only. It cannot authorize from rendered state, persist secret answers, settle an interaction locally, create a lifecycle row, or block navigation. Floret's typed current view remains the canonical interaction and tool outcome authority.

concepts.title: Flower citations
concepts.summary: Floret stores assistant sources with end-exclusive Unicode code-point ranges. Flower renders titled links and removes provider markers on Copy. Only safe credential-free HTTP(S) URLs link; marker IDs imply no URL. Historical gaps stay explicit and authored bibliographies remain content.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: Provider/gateway annotations preserve title, URL and optional positions. Floret validates and binds them to canonical assistant fragments for current/historical projections. Invalid URLs never link; metadata invalidates Markdown HTML without remounting stable code controls. Unmatched sources follow completed messages; markers without stored sources show localized unavailable text.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Published Floe Markdown parsing owns GFM syntax with CJK-aware emphasis boundaries for completed and streamed text. Display parsing never writes back to canonical messages or provider cache input. New messages preserve complete sources; old records lacking sources remain readable without rewriting historical data.

## Inline-code references
Inline Markdown code consumes the published Floe `--inline-code-foreground` and `--inline-code-background` pair directly, without desaturating assistant references. Prose and table references use `0.96em` and medium weight so compact identifiers remain readable beside CJK text. Linked references retain navigation affordances.

Porcelain Light uses deep burgundy ink on a pale rose inset. Normal and selected code text clear 7:1; the fill stays restrained while separating from the canvas by 1.14–1.2:1. The latter is a product design budget, not a control-boundary accessibility threshold. Acceptance includes dense mixed-language tables, both materials, desktop/narrow widths, native selection and theme-switch continuity.

Fenced code, copy behavior and canonical content remain independent.

Theme changes preserve focus, selection, DOM and geometry; see [message appearance](flower-message-appearance.md).

## Source-card presentation
Sources start collapsed, showing the count and a deduplicated stack of up to four website icons plus an overflow count. Sources never expose their own copy button. Inline citations retain their existing links.

## Website icons
The shared Flower UI bundles 27 common website marks from pinned theSVG assets with audited per-icon licenses. Icon enhancement runs independently after Markdown rendering; collapse/expand never restarts it.

The renderer receives image bytes, never a third-party tracking URL.

## Authored bibliography
Assistant Markdown can already contain an explicit bibliography inside an unlabelled, `text` or `plaintext` fence. This is display-only authored content: it neither fabricates canonical source annotations nor binds numeric prose references to provider metadata. User messages and fetched external Markdown do not enable this assistant-specific presentation.

frontmatter.title: Flower companion presence, composer and motion

concepts.summary: Collapsed Flower projects canonical work and connection-local editor intent through one retained textarea. Priority decides whether to show a decision, draft, status target or inspection. Shared shell motion preserves draft, selection, IME and focus; historical completion never becomes new feedback.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Presence
### Status and live output
Canonical priority is running, queued, attention, unread failure, unread cancellation, unread completion, unavailable, idle. Reduced motion disables flow/tracking/arrival effects while retaining semantic text/color. Live tails use matching current-run facts without exposing raw thinking. A collapsed Activity companion uses stable localized status and thread-title copy for running work; it does not render continuously changing assistant output or live-tail motion. Expanded and full Flower presentations retain live progress.

### Completion acknowledgement
Only a matching successful run previously observed running while collapsed may temporarily replace an idle editor with localized completion feedback. Exclude history, queued-only work, failures, cancellation, attention, expired/mismatched runs and completion while other running/queued work remains. Feedback is ephemeral, not canonical presence.

### Observation and transport
Use the shared workspace SSE; summaries cannot invent personal read state. Expansion requests current selected detail without a second stream; disconnect uses existing recovery.

### Composer precedence
One derived entry owns rendering/target, in this order:
1. Current-thread pending decision, regardless of question type or draft.
2. Ordinary editor for draft, attachment, reference, focus or IME; inspection if editing unavailable.
3. Eligible running, queued, unread-failure or ephemeral-completion target button.
4. Ordinary editor or read-only/unavailable inspection.

[Activity companion](flower-activity-companion.md#companion) owns question activation and one-shot focus handoffs.

## Composer
Settings recovery stays inside the collapsed row, with a reachable Retry and unchanged height. It replaces compact summary copy until recovery; active Stop remains available. The published shell cannot clip recovery outside its bounds. Expanded recovery uses the existing floating notice stack.

### Retained editor and explicit entry
The same ordinary editor moves between compact/detail presentations. Specialized decisions retain separate controls; input/approval/work priority follows [presence](#presence), never converts a decision/status entry into an editor.

### Editor layout and growth
Toolbar left stays empty; permission/model/reasoning remain in More during loading/errors. Recovery/guidance sit above the editor. Short input leaves no blank space beneath the toolbar; multiline growth moves it without replacing the editor. Dedicated pages retain complete starter suggestions.

### Motion and surface treatment
One shell grows upward/outward in width and height, preserving bottom edge, border, background and clipping. Close dissolves detail before compact layout; reversal follows current phase. Exit keeps fixed coordinates and Activity height, without origin flashes. Published forced-color and focus indicators remain. Composer disclosures follow [shared surface material](surface-material.md): portaled nested menus retain More ownership, Escape returns focus one level at a time, and exits stop accepting input immediately. Collapsed content uses only its compact composer inset; transcript/activity gutters apply to expanded content and cannot push the entry icon away from the left edge.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Presence is a read-only projection of canonical work and local composer intent. Placement and focus remain owned by the Activity companion contract; transport recovery remains owned by the shared Flower runtime boundary.

This concept owns content presentation only. [Flower companion presence](#presence) remains the owner of status precedence and workspace observation.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
The chat toolbar always retains its leftmost Plus attachment button. Thread-detail loads, model-capability refreshes and temporary editing restrictions disable it without removing its DOM node or shifting the toolbar. Every editable conversation can select attachments once its transport and capability are ready; read-only and unavailable states keep the same visible, disabled entry. Drafts and staged files remain scoped to their conversation.

Text above 50,000 Unicode code points converts only after successful staging.

Selection during capability loading retains queued local bytes. Invalid Unicode, drift, quota, upload/restore or pre-capture failure preserves the editor. Once captured, the transport outbox owns submission and explicit recovery; later failures never overwrite newer composer edits. Attachment-only sends never synthesize prompts; restoration never sends automatically.

All file types remain selectable and sendable regardless of model modalities or tool support. Upload limits and transport readiness remain authoritative; presentation routes never mark staged files incompatible. Model changes, revision changes and capability refreshes preserve staged readiness without uploading again. The model menu does not pre-judge attachment support or poll each model for attachment compatibility. Desktop IPC and Env App preview loaders accept canonical opaque bytes; preview availability does not decide whether a file can be sent. Models receive native content when supported or an honest attachment manifest and choose how to process it.

## Connection-local editing
Env App uses one Shell-owned coordinator across Activity/Workbench; Desktop uses one per connection, never a module singleton. Admission uncertainty retains request identity for reconciliation/retry.

## Queued content
Execution leaves select/paste/drop/reference controls usable. Users may add/remove/send resources; staged copies survive queue removal and canonical bytes remain immutable.

## Canonical Presentation
Previews use authenticated `loadMessageAttachment`: Env App prepares local credentials; Desktop uses scoped Runtime IPC GET with bounded canonical-MIME bytes. Chromium coverage includes 320 CSS pixels without horizontal overflow.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:

Canonical timeline projection does not fall back to a staged client snapshot when Floret membership is unavailable.

concepts.title: Flower references, origin context and canonical admission

frontmatter.title: Flower references, origin context and canonical admission

concepts.summary: Connection-local chips carry authorized discovery and frozen page/thread context into explicit Send. Floret alone owns admitted ordered references. Labels and paths grant no authority; source failures retain drafts and outbox reconciliation never overwrites newer input or creates duplicate canonical records.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Reference drafts
Launcher/Tessiven linked chips wrap/scroll in bounded input;editable @ requires whitespace boundary/collapsed caret. Focus changes color without changing1px geometry/shadow;retain candidate/action focus. Discover under immutable thread cwd or new-thread directory draft;slashless token uses bounded global matching. Root failures Retry,inaccessible descendants skip within bound.

Ordered file/directory/page/thread chips hold connection-memory local IDs/labels,never another connection/persistence. [Tool runtime](../ai/ai-tool-runtime.md#runtime) owns one-pass canonical MessageReference/context admission. Queue preview binds exact ThreadID/QueueID/ReferenceID;resubmit reauthorizes. Only outbox retains original ordinary launch until canonical confirmation/terminal cleanup;after admission read canonical references through current authorization,no second queryable mapping.

## Origin page
Capture requires no resource read or editor replacement; submission uses exact visible text, terminal current screen only, excluding unloaded/unauthorized facts.

Desktop Activity companion in both hosts captures origin immediately on explicit New or explicit open with no selected thread,including close reversal. Page switches/existing-thread opens never add context. Automatic reference alone cannot enable empty Send. Reuse context-preview/text component for draft/admitted snapshots without draft-authority transfer.

## Global Ask Flower

Redeven-owned pages expose pull readers through Floe's connection-local context-source registry. The deepest interacted source wins; menu/card focus preserves that origin. Instance IDs distinguish same-type Workbench widgets and retained preview tabs. Inputs, reading selections, file paths, terminal visible output, plugin identity and current thread identity are bounded facts, never instructions or execution authority. Hidden/inert sources cannot be captured. No background project scan is performed.

The global header action and `Mod+Shift+J` open one PromptCard; repeating the command focuses its existing draft. Activity, Workbench, preview overlays, standalone Tessiven and the Desktop launcher share this behavior. Desktop CodeSpace, Web Service and hosted application child windows forward title/credential-free URL through their session owner; they never gain shell IPC authority. User-opened external browsers and other OS applications are outside this scope.

Each fresh submission creates a task. Merely opening the card creates nothing. Context freezes at open; Send and unknown-admission Retry use the existing immutable request/staging path. No source watcher, automatic screenshot or model-driven capture continues during the answer.

### Explicit screenshots

The camera tool is the only screenshot trigger. It adds a previewable/removable image through ordinary attachment staging. Capture errors retain draft text and references; closing/reopening cancels the operation and discards late results. Source navigation or ownership changes reject the result, without silently choosing another window.

Desktop captures only the main-process-bound WebContents and visible region, with pre/post checks, visible privacy-marker rejection and bounded PNG size. Browser capture requires the native picker, a matching current-tab capture handle and native Region Capture. A bounded frame reader drains pre-crop frames and accepts the first new cropped frame; an explicit minimum frame rate keeps static sources responsive. Browsers without these verified capabilities report unavailable. Frames close and acquired tracks always stop. Prompt chrome remains mounted/focused but is omitted for the capture frame; it is restored before image encoding. Cross-origin embedded content is captured as pixels only, not inspected as host DOM; the image is a user-reviewed attachment, not a promise of automatic secret redaction.

## Reference previews

Preview the frozen reference body or queued attachment itself. Text snapshots are
selectable, scrollable plain text; they are not synthetic file paths or live
editor documents. Screenshot previews decode an object URL of the same File
that submission stages. Closing, replacing, or disposing the launcher releases
preview URLs and invalidates pending reads without changing the draft. Other
supported attachment formats use the existing bounded file renderers.

Keep identity and close controls in the header. Omit synthetic path/download
bars, queued-message descriptions, format-placeholder notices, and a duplicate
footer close action. Source navigation remains an explicit header action where
available. Actual truncation and failures remain visible. Context registration
wrappers preserve the full constrained flex viewport on desktop and mobile.

`desktop/scripts/check-ask-flower-previews.mjs --binary <runtime> --output <dir>`
qualifies the built Env App against an isolated real local Runtime: right-click
Files, inspect the exact frozen context, explicitly capture and open an image,
compare preview bytes and source pixels, reopen, and retain the draft. The global
Desktop acceptance also opens context/image references before new-task submission.

## Thread references
Right-click/More/keyboard menu appends current-draft reference without selecting source/sending. Shared type dispatch owns identity/serialization/description;thread never becomes filesystem path. [Thread tools](../ai/flower-thread-queries.md) authorize further reads. Existing draft owner handles dedupe/preview/remove/recovery.

## Context actions
One authorized privacy-checked mapper emits ordered MessageReference and UserInput.Context snapshots. Malformed/forged/unknown input or failed projection rejects admission and preserves editable drafts.

One assistant.ask.flower action carries target/source/presentation/typed items. Runtime enforces privacy matrix:file_path for files,terminal_selection for terminal,process_snapshot for monitoring,bounded text_snapshot for Git/environment. Never reconstruct references from product action copies. Product routing commands independently resolve/authorize environment target. Missing thread/reference means absence;other Floret failures remain unavailable,no product fallback.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body: Labels,paths/search/context are information,never filesystem/target/execution authority. They cannot change cwd,tool routing,permissions or attachment ownership. Floret owns admitted history;companion owns retained placement/dismissal/stream. Outbox cannot become canonical lifecycle or reference authority.

## Context-menu discovery

Shared Floe context actions capture a specific target, anchor and selection before
menu focus. Env App and Desktop prepare a frozen semantic source at that boundary.
Unhandled page/background requests show a compact menu; Workbench, file, terminal,
Git, preview and Flower menus retain their owner and richer object actions without
duplicate Ask Flower entries. Editing actions remain available. Desktop environment
cards use the clicked owner. Native owned windows forward through the existing
validated main-process source boundary. Remote pointer pixels and third-party
iframe documents retain their input ownership; host chrome and explicit commands
remain the supported entry points there. A context-menu selection does not capture
an image and never attaches to an existing task automatically.
Attachment staging loads its upload controller only when a submission contains
files; menu discovery must retain the existing initial-render asset budget.

Behavior coverage includes the actual canvas menu, nested preview selection,
object-action deduplication, background-to-new-task submission, and native
content-view menu ownership. Built Desktop acceptance also verifies the clicked
environment, explicit screenshots, attachments and unknown-admission retry.

concepts.title: Flower personal conversation preferences
concepts.summary: Explicit model, directory and model-owned reasoning choices are remembered per authenticated namespace, endpoint and user. Loading/switching threads never writes defaults. New roots prefer explicit launch/draft choices, then personal memory, then configuration; existing threads and immutable turns retain confirmed settings.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Ownership and persistence
`ai_conversation_preferences` belongs to product schema v11. Transactional v10→v11 validates source/target shapes, preserves data and never infers preferences from old threads. Missing stable scope cannot read another user's defaults.

## Selection events
Patch only the chosen field. Existing-thread edits must succeed before saving memory; memory failure cannot roll back confirmed thread state. Explicit Default differs from absent memory; Default/budget and Off/budget semantics remain.

## Drafts and admission
Draft overrides remain distinct from effective model/directory admission values; old selection cannot seed a new draft. Without explicit/remembered reasoning, root launch freezes explicit Default so retries cannot acquire later memory. Server [canonicalization](../ai/model-reasoning-runtime.md#runtime-capability) owns model capability. Existing busy/queued/unresolved-input edit restrictions apply.

## Concurrency and failure
Adapters serialize captured patches and load latest revision; the store atomically merges with compare-and-set. Stale writes return 409 without auto-retry. Captured target/model identity fences late responses against navigation or retargeting.

The originating surface consumes its authoritative response/settings revision without reloading shared model resources; other surfaces refresh persisted preferences. Catalog refresh is reserved for configuration changes, preventing model/reasoning selection from replacing the composer with loading UI.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body: This is Redeven product preference policy using already published Floret capabilities, not a generic upstream settings framework. Runtime catalogs, filesystem scope, canonical Thread settings, and immutable Turn execution remain authoritative. Model and directory recovery use existing controls and host notifications, not new switches, save buttons, or confirmation dialogs.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Navigation
One title/return header and separate icon tab bar serve Skills/MCP/Plugins. Persistent selected underline and Arrow/Home/End support keyboard use. Panels start with compact filter/actions, not repeated titles. Keep check timestamps in details. Decorative32px row icons preserve names/heights; no untrusted SVG/icon-only actions. [MCP icons](../ai/mcp-runtime.md#presentation-icons) owns discovery/storage.

## Skills and MCP
Usable connections load source/catalog metadata. Serialize reads/mutations against stale refresh; read-only browsing never installs bundled files.

MCP edits HTTP endpoints or local executable/one-argument-per-line. Never prefill secrets: omission preserves, explicit empty object clears. Retain search/enabled filter/tools/checks/confirmed removal. Default form shows connection type and endpoint or executable/arguments. Advanced holds optional name/ID with Automatic; existing IDs are read-only/selectable. Runtime allocates names/IDs, never client slugs. Add server creates; Save edits. Remote needs no introductory prose; enabled local saves explain execution once. Failure keeps drafts; reopening resets disclosure.

## Agent Plugins
Without sources show installed management directly: no Installed/Discover, official placeholders or discovery requests. With sources show distinct high-contrast view control and responsive cards. Keep separate searches/selected source; entering Discover loads it, switching/leaving fences late replies. Primary/local tabs differ visually. Omit raw environment IDs/repeated headings/introductory copy.

Empty Skills/MCP/Plugins use a concise factual title/direct action, without marketing, paragraphs or dashed frames. Installed search needs entries; configured discovery search remains during loading. Misses offer Clear filters. Cards open one detail dialog prioritizing description/enable/components; disclose hashes/configuration. Gallery avoids duplicate management. Keep execution/destruction consequences at the decision. Light/dark/narrow layouts remain readable without horizontal overflow.

Preparation/review/commit stay separate. Closing pending preview fences late polls while operation remains resumable. Failed requests keep input. Select components/enable explicitly; preparation executes nothing. Credentials use named password fields/replace/explicit clear, never returned secrets. Uninstall confirms separately, retaining data by default.

Owned Skills/MCP navigate repeatedly to plugin management rather than standalone mutations. Plugin changes invalidate mounted catalogs without resetting tabs/filters; late replies cannot reopen dismissed dialogs. Reader/admin/process permissions stay independent.

Manage sources is separate: admin-only mutations, retained failed input, Runtime-managed sources cannot be removed. Last removal returns installed view. Failure offers Retry, distinct from successful empty/search-miss. Metadata is inert, never approval. Cards enter existing preparation/review; package manifest owns preview. No official catalog. [Catalogs](../ai/flower-plugin-catalogs.md) owns activation/schema; [plugins](../ai/flower-agent-plugins.md) owns format/storage/update/permission.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
Stream recovery displays only canonical progress attempts/deadlines. [Live delivery](flower-live-timeline.md#retention-and-recovery) owns local read failure, revision fencing, one bounded window refresh and connection recovery; reader failure cannot restart the workspace stream.

Before accepted detail, show one floating error/Retry above the transcript without consuming its height or duplicating workspace/composer notices. The shared [notice stack](flower-live-timeline.md#retention-and-recovery) preserves error explanations and recovery controls while keeping loaded messages and the composer stationary. Unconfirmed Stop remains separate. Loaded conversations retain live-sync recovery; embedded views omit global navigation. Leaving a read fences its completion and preserves Shell drafts without replay.

Full child reports bypass ordinary preview limits but retain provider budget; canonical Retry reuses confirmed complete reports without tool dispatch. [Historical compatibility](../ai/flower-upgrade-compatibility.md) owns supported migration evidence rather than a UI-pinned schema version.

sections.title: Boundaries

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Transcript reading scale
Assistant/user text uses `0.875rem` and unitless `1.75` line height. Composer controls retain published control scale.

## Assistant reading roles
Body/headings retain the chat foreground. Presentation does not rewrite Markdown or infer metadata from authored bold text, dates, identifiers or citations. [Citations](flower-citations.md) own destinations/copy.

## Filled messages and content
Sent text/answered-question receipts mix 4% theme foreground into the published `floe-well-on-plane` fill for clearer separation from the content canvas, with `floe-radius-group` corners and 16px horizontal padding. Reading ink derives from the theme foreground with stronger light/dark luminance; ordinary text, full questions and answers share that ink and the transcript reading scale. Across published presets and both materials, body ink clears 7:1 and is no weaker than assistant ink on the same capsule surface. Only status/redacted metadata is secondary. Queued input retains its separate paint and spacing.

Answered receipts retain every complete question followed by its answer in canonical order, without disclosure or choices. Questions use regular weight, answers medium weight, and a quiet check accompanies the localized status. Spacing and thin neutral separators distinguish multiple responses. Short receipts fit their content without a minimum-width panel.

Text, placeholders and actions share the right edge; the full-row history wrapper makes the 78% desktop bubble limit relative to the transcript. Short text fits intrinsically; narrow views retain the full-column limit. Error/code insets use readable foreground and selection roles over their own backgrounds.

## Queued input beside the composer
The shared Flower component owns queue presentation in both hosts, using published Floe theme roles. A queue is a borderless, shadowless list of 32px single-line rows with a quiet neutral fill, 2px between rows and 4px above the composer. Long labels retain their complete text through truncation and the native tooltip. The list scrolls at the smaller of 10rem or 30% of viewport height. Host styles must not duplicate the retired queue-panel layout.

Drag, edit, send-now, delete and attachment/reference previews retain their existing authority and behavior. Action hit areas remain at least 24px, reserve their width and reveal on hover or keyboard focus; touch controls remain visible. Focus, pending feedback and stream updates must not move neighboring controls.

## User media and resources
Order is image thumbnails, wrapping resource cards, text bubble, then timestamp/copy. Resource/image-only messages omit empty bubbles. Canonical previews use exact thread/turn/reference identity; queued actions retain their separate authority/click guard.

## Native text selection
Filled text, including transparent table headers, reverses capsule ink and fill for visible native selection; code and queued insets retain their own selection roles. Selection never changes parsing, copying or transport. Browser checks require 4.5:1 supporting/selected text and a visible selection surface across all presets/materials. Copying answered receipts retains complete ordered questions/answers and the localized hidden-answer placeholder. [Highlighting](flower-code-highlighting.md) retains its own stable-content contract.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Mechanism
The composer always keeps its model label visible without an availability spinner or busy status.

The model picker aligns to the logical start edge of its trigger through the published Floe anchored-layer API, retaining surface boundary clamping. Its bounded scroll viewport exposes the complete configured catalog; selection and recent thread activity never reorder provider groups or model rows. Alias folding retains the selected identity in the original catalog slot. Closing retains the displayed selection and rows until unmount. Search, keyboard navigation, unavailable rows and management remain available. Selection focus restores only after saving and exit settle, to the visible model entry or More button, without overriding a newer focus choice.

Runtime status distinguishes no Desktop provider (`not_configured`), configured but unavailable keys or catalog (`missing_keys` or `empty`), and actual connection or protocol errors.

## Model identity and recovery
Thread snapshots, list items, and patches carry `model_id` and `reasoning_selection` as thread defaults. The last is a disabled, ungrouped display of a thread's missing model; Flower never silently replaces it.

See [reasoning selection ownership](../ai/model-reasoning-runtime.md#selection-controls) for loading, draft, and submission rules.

## Web search presentation
Model choices display the shared search badge from the server's readonly `web_search` projection. A provider brand or frontend model name never enables search. See [model directory ownership](../ai/model-directory-and-selection.md).

## Permission and navigation
Below the 768px viewport breakpoint, the composer keeps permission status and selection in its own More panel, alongside any other overflow controls.

Saving disables only the permission control, prevents duplicate requests, merges the authoritative settings response, and restores the confirmed value on failure.

Warm sessions switch without provider or transcript remount and stale loads cannot replace the current thread.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Flower does not treat the global model or permission as an existing-Thread launch override. After creation, its `model_id`, `reasoning_selection`, and `permission_type` are authoritative; Thread changes write to its settings, while new-thread overrides stay connection-local and never update environment defaults.

The header switcher is only a product-specific compact presentation; it does not create a second selected-thread owner or change the requested, committed, and content-presented ordering.

concepts.summary: Floret request facts drive output indicators; frozen tool schemas drive bounded provisional names/counts. Stable geometry keeps metrics readable without repeated announcements. Confirmed results replace previews, and failed edits retain only actual mutations without giving provisional paths filesystem authority.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Output progress
### Model request
Each logical request and attempt has its own start, first-output time, last semantic-progress time and estimated received output tokens. Local tools, approvals and user input never use this model-pause presentation.

Only phase text is a live region; numerical updates are readable without repeated automatic announcements.

### Indicator geometry
A live run indicator holds one width while it reports. Inside a host that gives it a bounded track, the mark and phase label keep a constant start inset, the token-and-clock metric keeps a constant end inset, and digits grow only in the free space between them. Reveal dots reserve their full width instead of animating it, so no tick resizes or recenters the indicator. The [subagent detail window](flower-subagent-detail.md#detail-window) supplies that track in its footer rail.

### Progress symbol
The shared Flower mark retains its five-petal geometry.

The symbol is decorative beside the existing localized status text and does not create another live announcement or execution state.

### Edit arguments
The frozen tool definition supplies one optional argument preview parser per call. Their input budget is 1 MiB per call, with bounded JSON depth and field counts.

[Confirmed file Activity](#confirmed-file-activity) remains the durable outcome.

## Edit preparation
Tool schemas are the single declaration-order authority. For `apply_patch`, Redeven observes complete canonical Add/Update/Delete headers and optional Move headers before the body finishes.

Actual result names and counts replace previews on settlement. A failed patch
shows only confirmed mutation diffs before its error, retaining the error status
and stable disclosure row. Validation failure shows no completed-edit preview.
A partial Move presents the confirmed destination create/update, not a rename.
Confirmed local mutation targets support the existing authorized file navigation;
preview paths and unconfirmed operations never acquire file actions.

## Confirmed file activity
[Task files](../ai/flower-task-files.md) add explicit verified delivery results and a
shared Files panel. The structured result links to the confirmed user destination;
intermediates remain in a separate expandable working-file section.

Published Floret v7.30.0 owns the product-neutral file Activity payload. A read carries bounded content and line metadata.

[Preview recovery](file-preview-window-actions.md#window-actions) keeps unavailable targets actionable without changing historical content.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Floret owns request accounting and ephemeral thread snapshots. Redeven's pure argument parsers supply only display names and optional counts; they cannot authorize or execute edits. Canonical tool results remain the only durable change facts, and supersede every provisional count.

Candidate names never create file actions, authorize paths, admit tool execution, or become durable conversation state. Current views use the existing [Flower live timeline](flower-live-timeline.md) transport and publication owner.

Activity presentation is not a filesystem authority or a second mutation record. The canonical tool result and Floret Activity lifecycle remain the owners of execution and persistence. Display names are not paths, line counts cannot prove current workspace state, and the UI never fetches a file or recomputes a diff merely to populate a historical row.

A one-record frozen-leaf read validates ancestry before reusing settled non-interaction admission facts; unadmitted and all interaction receipts require status pages. A rejected old path triggers canonical interval replacement. Authorization and transport errors never establish ancestry. This avoids retransmitting an expanded settled archive on every source notification, without adding polling, subscriptions or a durable projection.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Provider configuration
### Connection setup
OpenAI offers API keys or verified local ChatGPT accounts. Registration and model selection stay independent; endpoints stay flat and permissions unchanged.

### Kimi
One Kimi choice offers API or Kimi Code. Drafts isolate keys, endpoints and models; close clears them. Switching rejects stale discovery. Saved methods stay fixed; add another connection to change service. Cards label methods; IDs, aliases, selections and history stay unchanged.

Use short names and access labels. Explain keys, quotas and saved methods in the access tooltip; model limits in the model tooltip. Icon links open official guidance. Code keeps regional endpoints and reviewed IDs; billing never falls back.

### Search and secrets
Provider and model search switches must both be on; preferences remain editable when provider search is off. Backend policies own availability. See [failure recovery](flower-failure-recovery.md). Stored keys use fixed dot placeholders. Null removes a key; omitted/blank patches preserve it. Catalog refresh never selects new models.

### DeepSeek Fetch
Omitted Fetch configuration uses direct GET fetching. DeepSeek Fetch is opt-in
inside the DeepSeek provider dialog. Explicit existing DeepSeek selections are
preserved; this does not disable the separate search capability. HTML Preview
is described as an available rendering capability without recommending its use.

## ChatGPT selection
Verified signed-in accounts differ from saved connections. Sign-out retains a compact summary; explicit removal forgets only a signed-out local registration. Host owns protected persistence/admission.

### Account selection and recovery
The shared dialog offers ChatGPT account and API key methods. Selecting an entry never starts OAuth or saves a provider.

Account persistence, renewal and cancellation belong to the [account lifecycle](../ai/chatgpt-account-lifecycle.md#account-lifecycle); local admission belongs to the [authentication contract](../ai/chatgpt-account-lifecycle.md#local-admission).

### Connection feedback and continuity
The connection panel groups account identity, state guidance, and actions. Background reads of known accounts never remount a loading picker. All stages use the shared Desktop and Env styles and explicit localized copy.

sections.title: Contract

Flower read state is a Redeven-owned per-user activity watermark. A separate loaded-content revision prevents metadata or private confirmations from qualifying stale body content as current.

No storage format or historical watermark is reset.

Neither a detail response nor a hidden measuring transcript qualifies as
presentation. Selection telemetry and read acknowledgement wait until the
[destination presentation boundary](flower-thread-selection.md) releases its
prepared viewport, then retain the existing visible-document and content-revision
checks.

Foreground visibility is an input, not a second asynchronous readiness lifecycle.
The selected detail loader and destination presentation boundary own readiness;
returning to the foreground only requests their existing coalesced refresh.
Navigation, reselect, canceled reads and failed refreshes must not strand a
surface-wide readiness flag or prevent another presented thread from confirming
its content revision. Hidden, covered, loading and failed content remains
unacknowledged through the presentation checks themselves.

This boundary adds no polling, detail payload, list refresh, or backend storage.
Acknowledgements retain one in-flight request per thread, monotonic confirmation
and the existing retry policy. Repeated presentation of the same confirmed
revision sends no additional acknowledgement.

concepts.title: Flower setup and settings

Retained modal preserves saves/errors and makes covered chat inert without read acknowledgement; existing model/permission/recovery owns policy.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## First-time setup
Welcome setup requires no selected thread, configured provider or usable model, and absent/`not_configured`/`empty` Desktop source. Desktop `local_host` opens the current surface's settings, never another Welcome window or a remote destination. Artwork has no glow or continuous animation.

The unconfigured surface is one open, canvas-level composition using published Floe ink and Button interaction, with no card, icon tile, heavy heading or filled call-to-action. It contains the Flower mark, setup title, one short explanation and the available settings destinations. Local setup has one text action; remote Desktop setup keeps distinct Desktop and environment text actions with concise localized labels. No model-sync control or starter-task previews appear before configuration. Existing settings updates restore the retained composer and draft when a model becomes usable; configured-model recovery remains in its existing settings/menu owner.

## Starter tasks
Four editable drafts cover current-folder understanding, connected computer, installed applications and folder organization. Names/dates alone never justify deletion. The [companion](flower-activity-companion.md#companion) omits the grid.

## Settings composition
Settings edit the environment profile even with a Desktop model source. Flat sections preserve identity/drafts. Immediate switches block duplicate edits and roll back on failure.

## Provider configuration
[Provider configuration](flower-provider-configuration.md#provider-configuration) owns authentication, layout and connection-before-model sequencing.

## Retained panels
FlowerSurface retains chat/extensions and a lazily loaded settings form in a bounded scrollable modal. Covered chat/navigation remain inert through close and do not acknowledge reads. Settings interactions belong to the companion: dialog close keeps it expanded; host collapse closes both while retaining form/progress/errors.

## Saving and ownership
Independent adapter operations save permission, model profile and default model. Permission uses a serialized 700 ms coalescing controller, fences older responses and restores the last confirmed value on failure. Computer-use failures restore the confirmed switch and expose errors.

sections.body:

## Incremental owners
Indexed records initialize from snapshots. Text/extent updates preserve window/turn/decoration identity;structural changes alone recompute membership. Argument previews touch one block,never completed tools. Validate counters/retire withdrawn attempts. Real removal restores adjacent action/composer focus unless navigation moved it.20appends over100/10000archived items must read zero historical ordinals.
