Prompt history observes user content/status only;Activity counts follow replaced blocks. Placement touches changed membership/registration,retaining borrowed DOM/focus/selection/prepend anchors. Tail inspection checks blockers without old-row geometry;immediate disclosure avoids unused measurements.

Reuse block classification while final/intermediate/live/outcome stays current;Computer candidates subscribe to relevant targets only. Observed wire window is distinct from retained reading document:wire-only changes cannot rebuild archive/rescan ordinals. Actual ownership/order/coverage/lifecycle publish atomically. Canonical order needs linear check;out-of-order receipts/decorations stable-sort with uncommitted tail intact. Compare unchanged source ranges before copying groups/partitions. Sparse keyed facts visit fewer source keys rather than broadcast absence;updates/removals synchronous. Regressions:2400rows/100partitions,reversed input/decorations,600sparse subscribers,600groups+append.

DOM mutation reads no offsets/extents. Nested-tail/disclosure joins existing before-paint pass;explicit reopen restores follow,transferred anchors retain offset. Capture native input offset before default action. Same-run snapshots retain presentation/equal collections;wire replacement cannot rebind every retained layout controller. New execution gets prefix-validated presentation. Content advances on text owner.

Measure history gaps after accepted membership in same batch while old DOM mounted;only removed interior rows contribute height,preserved/appended rows need no historical geometry. Keep gap/virtual anchors. Running turns cannot fold;inspect protection runs when eligible,retaining terminal focus/selection/manual choices. Row registration cannot enumerate unchanged groups.

Published createIncrementalMarkdownParser owns Marked/CJK/GFM:reset full baseline,append regions,finish complete correction. Changed snapshot resets;reuse only exact token identity/offsets,same-source metadata retains regions. Completion/collapse/replacement retains all authored blocks. [Code](flower-code-highlighting.md),[diagrams](markdown-diagrams.md),[media](flower-inline-media.md) keep separate ownership.

## Text/layout
New prose fades currentColor320ms through20fixed CSS highlights,no node splits/layout/delivery delay. History/corrections immediate,links/code/media keep ink. No stylesheet/computed-style/per-frame inline work. Bound32groups/owner,diff8192chars/128nodes per region;larger immediate. Completion settles;reset/dispose/hidden/reduced-motion/forced-colors clears. Hot drag/resize settles ink while text/selection/DOM stay live;only later arrivals animate. Both hosts pin Tailwind's Lightning CSS optimizer to 1.33.0 through matching npm/pnpm overrides. Version 1.32.0 warns on valid `::highlight()` selectors. Keep all 20 phase colors through optimization and minification; do not suppress warnings or disable optimization. `scripts/flower_streaming_css.test.mjs` exercises each installed Tailwind plugin's optimizer in both modes; host gates select their own cases.

Cold sealed bodies stage across reconnect then reveal final geometry without height motion;sample table/code/list/text from first frame. Other prose stays incremental. Font completion/error listeners dispose,not detached ready promises. Companion reads latest relevant record/bounded Unicode tail. Measured offscreen sections retain DOM with content-visibility:auto/intrinsic height;near/live/focused/selected explicitly visible. Intersection controls measurement,never paint admission:scrollbar jump must paint before callback,including compositor/native-wheel blank-frame checks. Existing scroll owner corrects before paint.

## Queue/verification
One ordered queue applies reactive batches;cooperative4ms includes reactions,yields between envelopes,never preempts one. Catch inside batch to publish recovery before rethrow. Ready waits drain,other reads pause16frames/1MiB;epoch/failure/dispose releases/fences.

Coalesce contiguous one-item append only with exact thread/item/turn/run/reading revision/same attempt except time/monotonic progress. Keep semantic boundaries/clears,join once preserving UTF8/version;gap rejects pending batch/one sync error. Bounds64frames/4MiB/250ms or75ms hot interaction. Semantic timer may replace stalled rAF,never overtake growth. Accept one32MiB envelope+reserve with backpressure. Diagnostics timing/kind/structural counts only,including slowest envelope;no content. Copy success1.6s,denial never success.

Real-Service qualifier freezes history/cadence,measures Runtime/Electron CPU/allocation/wire/frame/input/click/output then verifies every prose/thinking item via actual disclosure against canonical content. [Long-thread](../operations/flower-long-thread-gate.md) owns sustained/floating acceptance;explicit suites outside unified gates. Synthetic post-timing mutation samples prove no provider/encryption/peak-memory guarantee.

Structured response_validation after response.completed retains arrived content with localized final-verification failure,collapsed copyable safe conflict details. Peer text stays literal,no automatic retry. Accepted source-only hosted-search variation creates no error card. Both hosts retain complete identical catalogs.

frontmatter.title: Flower child task navigation and detail window

concepts.summary: Authorized parent inventory controls child navigation; canonical thread identity chooses portraits and task labels. The detail window reads bounded current state without selecting the parent or creating another stream. Stable capsules, dropdowns and footer preserve reading geometry through updates and failures.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Task presentation
The parent header replaces the numeric robot badge with at most three circular canonical portraits and a separate `+N` remainder.

Single-target operations place the compact portrait/name capsule beside the action title. A deferred target field reserves the same line from its summary, before action or identity reads finish. Loading and read failures stay in that slot; long names truncate without wrapping. Touch targets and enlarged fonts retain stable row geometry. Creation failures retain their error details.

The existing field reader remains the sole read owner. Header rendering adds no request, polling, measurement loop, or child-detail prefetch. Portraits use bundled SVG selected by canonical `thread_id`. An identity without authorized parent membership remains informational; only the existing parent inventory enables child navigation. Name-only targets use the same compact capsule without inventing a portrait or navigation identity, including deferred fields and creation failures. Creation titles contain only the action; the capsule owns the task name and its full tooltip.

[Subagent detail window](#detail-window) owns complete current-view reads, live replacement, Activity rendering, child navigation, and queued-input controls.

## Detail window
The detail GET returns exactly `{ summary, current }` and accepts no paging query. Child currents use the same bounded unsent-text coalescing and transient browser-frame rules as roots, described by [live current transport](flower-live-timeline.md).

The window stacks three in-flow regions: a facts band, the transcript region, and an optional run-progress footer. The footer is a sibling of the transcript region, never an overlay, so a live run indicator can neither cover message text nor change the transcript's measured top and height. The footer centers one fixed-width pill under the window's inline center; [received output progress](flower-output-progress.md#output-progress) owns the pill's stability rules.

Floret remains the lifecycle owner described in [Subagent runtime](../ai/subagent-runtime.md#child-runtime).

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Flower must not recover a missing child identity from activity sidecars, a title, a delegated approval alias, a fallback thread id, or local state.

The dropdown lists tasks only. The empty trigger uses Floe's outline Workflow
icon; canonical portrait stacks remain for existing agents. Empty dropdowns use
a compact text row without an oversized illustration or placeholder card. The published
SurfaceAnchoredLayer owns measured placement, local surface boundaries and
viewport updates, with a six-pixel gap. Never position from an estimated menu
width. Shared floating presence retains entry/exit motion and disables exiting
content; shared overlay masking owns outside dismissal. Arrow/Home/End navigation
and Escape focus restoration remain product task-list semantics.

The detail window must not infer membership from activity, poll for updates, switch the selected parent conversation, persist a second transcript, or replay uncertain effects. [Subagent detail presentation](#task-presentation) owns parent membership, task labels, dropdown and operation capsules.

concepts.title: Flower terminal activity presentation
concepts.summary: Flower renders canonical Floret Activity with host task labels and safe details for every terminal operation, including writes/empty reads. Disclosure/scroll are ephemeral; no stdin/private paths/effect internals or invented lifecycle. Approval controls remain composer-owned.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Terminal facts
Floret owns the nested `ActivityItem.presentation` contract and merges results with their stable call presentation. Labels and descriptions are authoritative; the typed operation supplies localized fallback text.

The five-line independently scrolling output viewport retains its existing owner.

An omitted output field is pending content, never an empty canonical frame with a nonzero first sequence. Wait for small-field hydration before polling or installing its sequence; large fields use source-bound ranges, then acknowledge their watermark before adding process deltas. Existing output and selection survive handoff.

Published Floret v7.95.0 atomic activity reads own the bytes, sequence range, process identity and deferred source together. Flower never stamps a newer summary's range onto previously accepted bytes. Canonical activity status remains current independently. Check execution identity and range before publishing optional details; retain accepted output on failure. One in-flight read coalesces revisions; failure latches until explicit Retry, visibility reentry or connection change. Collapsed/offscreen rows do not read. No additional backend scan, transcript snapshot or transport contract is introduced.

Malformed process output stops its local poll and exposes a localized read-only Retry without raw diagnostics; other messages and stream observation continue. Canonical stream validation still fails at its existing connection boundary. Write acknowledgements never apply hidden output frames. Equal-watermark snapshots may fill an empty frame or extend its earlier coverage, but duplicate/older snapshots cannot replace a newer live suffix.

Inactive output caches have 200-entry / 8 MiB estimated-byte limits. Mounted outputs remain retained until release; frame metadata coalesces after 128 records without changing sequence checks. These cache limits do not truncate an active process output or its canonical history.

## Output, completion and restart
The model keeps four tools: terminal.exec/read/write/terminate. Read/write/terminate
descriptions are optional; read uses the last returned sequence. Each page is
bounded without an outer second truncation, and chunk boundaries preserve UTF-8.
The process retains at most 1 MB; gaps and invalid source encoding remain explicit.

Redeven binds the process identity to Floret before Start. Confirmed completion
seals bounded output and result facts through Floret, then supplies one bounded
notice at provider preparation or a natural idle continuation. Explicit final
reads suppress duplicate delivery. The original execution's model, tool scope,
reasoning and budgets are retained; cumulative budgets still apply per run.

Shutdown suspends new execution, reaps owned processes and persists observed
results before closing Floret. Abnormal exit preserves unknown outcomes without
replaying commands, resending stdin or adopting PIDs. Historical output reads
use authorized thread/process identity. Unknown observations stop UI polling;
readable sealed output remains paginated. Final Activity updates the original
item through Floret's canonical presentation sources.

## Interaction boundary
[Activity disclosure interaction](flower-activity-interaction.md) owns stable triggers, manual choices, animation, transcript following, and floating controls across all renderers. Approval state is never a row badge, chip, metadata line, title suffix, tooltip, detail, or ordinary activity ARIA label. Completing a decision removes that dock without inserting an approval outcome into history.

Floret v7.103.0 exposes unknown as a terminal Activity status and attention reason.
Flower preserves its count, keeps the row outside successful/active sequences,
uses a localized warning label, and retains readable historical output. The row
does not imply success or authorize command retries. An unknown observation is
not active polling work; available retained pages may still be read to completion.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Activity details are designed renderer views, never arbitrary payload inspectors.

Presentation never changes Floret status, ordering, persistence, read acknowledgement, audit state, or terminal settlement.

concepts.summary:
Flower acknowledges navigation before transcript work. One coordinator serves
navigation, command confirmation and reference preflight. ThreadCache owns
selection and detail; the loader owns bounded ephemeral demand.
Readiness controls reveal; elapsed time controls feedback only.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Selection and navigation
Rail feedback precedes commit by two animation callbacks and a task; hidden documents skip frames. Latest intent supersedes prior work; summaries cannot bypass coordination. Reveal after required baseline/handoff, measurable layout and visible historical text settle. Cached windows renew bounded interest if needed; ready caches prepare immediately. Never await runtime quiet. Canceled reads cannot release newer selections.

One loader owns selection/reselect/reconnect/retry. Position transcript and active sequence after placement before reveal. Restored titles/groups/turns are static; folded turns cannot block readiness, and manual folds retain labels. No smooth initial positioning or timer fallback. One cancellable 200 ms feedback deadline spans detail/body/layout without delaying ready/error state. New chat/navigation/disposal cancels old feedback; frame/composer stay stable and body failures retry locally.

Cached destinations flush effects and use checkVisibility({contentVisibilityAuto:true}). ResizeObserver corrects above-viewport growth before paint; rAF/visibility handles reveal/body work. No polls/per-row observers. Explicit wheel/touch/scrollbar/keyboard pauses following through late reads; scroll events alone do not. Two slots prioritize visible/margin text and cancel obsolete demand; ThreadCache retains immutable bodies. Growth/refresh/completion preserves accepted prose/selection. [Live delivery](flower-live-timeline.md) owns validation/retry. Open Latest; reading restoration is separate. Sort by creation descending then ThreadID ascending.

## Continuous history and concurrent activity
Scrolling reads canonical windows automatically, retaining visible/selected/focused rows, details and anchors across live changes. A collapsed short tail retains trailing room during prepend; reclaim it only outside view or as content fills it. Resize preserves anchors; destination preparation clears temporary geometry. Attach content observation after mount and correct growth before paint, without new reads/state/disclosure changes.

Latest remains above the composer away from current tail, even at a historical window bottom; hide during preparation and preserve gesture protection. If tail is installed, smooth-scroll and retire trailing room at arrival. Otherwise cancel obsolete demand, install one bounded tail interest and reveal its prepared destination without walking pages. Root/child share this path.

Observer/reading revision own accepted baselines. Ordered delivery/deduplication cannot discard distinct baselines at equal canonical version; full-view watermarks cannot suppress reading baselines. Retire obsolete refresh markers without invalidating newer interest. Queue budgets remain unchanged.

Collapsed ranges use canonical skip-and-retain to reach prior dialogue. One explicit reading gesture continues across advancing folded-only pages until readable content appears or the canonical edge is reached. It does not require another gesture per failed/retry turn. Each page retains the existing item/byte budgets; no-progress, read failure, disclosure changes and superseding navigation stop continuation. Explicit disclosure shows cached rows immediately and completes only its sequence: one request/document, 40 records/page, finite forward horizon. No full-content button/replacement observer. Show one geometry-neutral indicator after 150 ms; cancellation hides it immediately and only failure exposes Retry. Disclosure changes cancel obsolete navigation; thread/child/Latest clears gap demand. Headers follow canonical order and transfer focus to earlier owners.

Tools/reports retain previews; disclosure reads authorized bodies through the existing owner. Collapse/navigation/disposal cancels unused demand; reconnect restores consumers. Empty activity sources use Floret defaults in source order. Canonical unknown tool outcomes remain readable with an explicit localized unknown label; they are never converted to success, retried, or rejected as malformed history. Ordinary history retains full expansion; demand pages use published Floret v7.91.0 source-backed summaries without enumerating all turn tools. Runtime document owns mutable live records/versions. No universal latency or expanded-output memory guarantee.

## Detail read ownership
Floret supplies canonical summaries/windows/body reads. ThreadCache owns selection/detail with twelve entries; one bounded coordinator shares navigation, command confirmation and reference preflight. Cancellation never reconnects the workspace stream.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Published Floret v7.103.1 reduces execution preparation reads through upstream
source locators. The host retains bounded windows, visibility-driven body reads
and interaction state. First-use preparation of older prompt histories is
cancellable and yields between transactions. It is separate from transcript
readiness and never authorizes a full-history UI load. Formal qualification uses
the checksummed published module without workspace or sibling source wiring.
Exact token counts reuse an upstream vocabulary-scoped, bounded digest-only cache;
attribution, budgets and canonical storage remain unchanged.

The [sidebar contract](flower-thread-sidebar.md) owns conversation rows, title editing, pending-action presentation and pin ordering. A completed detail read alone never marks content as seen. Canonical View and Summary stay in Floret; the host does not reconstruct its history or lifecycle.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Resizing
One 220–380 CSS-pixel preference owns desktop sidebar width. Inline resizing updates only its grid track, at most once per frame; drawer width applies only in overlay mode. Mobile, companion and embedded layouts keep their sizing.

One primary-pointer gesture retains the latest sample and settles on release, cancellation, lost capture, blur, layout change or unmount. Release listeners, frames and cursor/selection shielding; persist once per gesture or immediately for keyboard changes. Storage failure cannot interrupt interaction. Width changes cannot reparse Markdown or invalidate the full transcript.

## Rename from the conversation header
The header pencil edits the existing ThreadID, including during execution/loading, with canonical title prefilled and selected. Header/sidebar share one save owner and thread cache.

## Selection and detail reads
[Selection](flower-thread-selection.md) owns deferred commitment, bounded reads, cancellation and recovery. ThreadCache owns committed selection/detail; sidebar intent reserves feedback only.

## Reference action
Right-click, More and Shift+F10 share the ThreadID-owned menu. [References](flower-composer-references.md#thread-references) own deduplication, preview, admission and recovery.

## Context menu response
Sidebar and transcript context menus are fully visible on the first frame, without an entrance transition. Use published Floe compact row/control tokens on desktop and retain 44px touch targets. The shared resize observer supplies the measured client border box to `SurfaceFloatingLayer`; Floe owns clamping and projected coordinates. Live action changes remeasure without replacing the menu or losing focus. Long paths remain truncated with the full path available on hover. Destructive actions use the published `--error` token for text and a 10% error tint on pointer hover and keyboard focus; disabled actions retain their disabled presentation.

Transcript selections copy the exact captured text even after menu focus moves. Right-clicking a message without a selection exposes Copy message through the existing normalized message-copy boundary, evaluated only on the user action. Message identity is weakly associated with its mounted row; no full transcript scan or backend read is added. Links, editors, embedded previews and terminal output retain their own context-menu ownership.

## Pending replies and approvals
Localized reply/approval labels appear beside the title with bounded status/progress width. Background updates use the workspace stream without selection.

## Pin ordering
The stable `.flower-thread-rows` owner contains inline size for real/skeleton rows; movable cards cannot be size containers. Keyboard order matches visible search/pin-overlay order. Time and directory views share one leading pinned region, ordered by canonical global rank; keyboard, menu and drag moves cross directory boundaries. Pins never appear again inside a directory. The global pinned heading identifies pinned conversations; rows have no persistent decorative pin. Their leading slot remains available for running/unread state. Hover/focus reveals the actionable pin; touch keeps the action reachable. Pinning and unpinning retain the row and focus, expanding its batch when necessary. Failed pin operations undo only their own presentation and reconcile via the existing summary stream or one explicit command read.

## Directory view
The title row contains the published Floe segmented control beside the workspace and refresh actions. It switches between creation-time and full working-directory groups with one moving selected face using the published slow duration and settle curve, so the short icon-only travel remains visible. At narrow widths its icons retain accessible names and tooltips while labels hide; the control never takes a separate row. Directory groups contain only unpinned conversations; even a collapsed directory cannot hide its global pins. Expanded directory headers show the published open-folder icon; collapsed headers show the closed-folder icon in the same fixed-size slot, synchronized with `aria-expanded`. Directories containing only pins remain available for creating new conversations. Search includes the full path; duplicate directory names expose their distinct paths. Each group shows six conversations, adds six per request and resets that limit on collapse. Directory headers use the folder state without a disclosure arrow. Conversations occupy the full row width without indentation or a tree rail, preserving horizontal space for titles; counts align at the trailing edge. The incremental-load label aligns with conversation titles. A collapsed group displays the running wave immediately before its new-conversation button only when it contains unpinned running or stopping work, including work beyond the visible batch. The existing summary grouping pass counts activity once per update; headers read this aggregate without per-header scans, backend queries, polling or transcript reads. Explicit disclosure moves one reveal edge across the batch, animating actual row heights and opacity without compressing the spacing of all lines at once with Floe's slow duration (280ms) and settle curve. JavaScript converts both CSS `ms` and `s` tokens to milliseconds; production minification must not shorten the animation by a factor of 1,000. The first and middle frames must visibly travel rather than consuming nearly all height in an entrance snap; the following directory stays below the shrinking content. Departing rows retain their original flow slots, become inert and accessibility-hidden immediately, then unmount at zero height. Reversal starts from measured height and opacity and reuses their identity. Directory reorder retains its separate bounded position animation. Running waves and focus survive retained moves. Background updates and search remove rows immediately. Mode switches use a brief opacity change without remounting retained rows; reduced motion disables these transitions. The directory's new-conversation action starts a draft in that directory without changing personal defaults.

Directory order and the selected view are local preferences scoped to the host environment. Desktop supplies its existing durable state-storage bridge so preferences survive ephemeral renderer partitions and complete process restarts; Env App supplies its UI storage adapter. Hosts migrate a previously saved renderer preference when their own storage has none. Storage failure leaves the current preference and interaction usable. The directory title row supports dragging without a separate grip icon or redundant focus stop with a pointer-following folder/count preview and an insertion line at the whole group's boundary. One animation frame owns preview, measured target and bounded edge scrolling; ordinary pointer movement never persists order. Release commits the displayed target once. Escape, cancellation, blur, teardown and release outside the rail discard the gesture and clean preview, listeners, cursor and frames. Starting a drag settles pending list motion. Alt+Up/Down and touch long-press provide equivalent movement; ordinary touch swipes still scroll. Search disables reordering.

The workspace dialog uses published Floe Dialog/Card surfaces and theme tokens. Inset cards flow down two independent columns in directory order (down the first column, then the second). Expanding a batch never rebalances cards between columns. The search row stays fixed above the sole results scroller; narrow screens use one column and touch controls retain 44px targets. Published Floe owns control radii, selected surfaces and dialog presence; product styles own layout and hierarchy only. A leading global pinned region precedes every workspace card and participates in the same search. Cards contain unpinned conversations, incremental loading and directory creation. Cards retain path identity; one row owner moves ThreadID-keyed rows between the global pinned region and workspace containers, preserving focus and running-wave continuity across summary and pin updates. Choosing a conversation clears an obstructing sidebar filter, reveals its global pin or opens its directory, extends only the required batch and scrolls the row into view. Unpinning into a collapsed directory expands it and the required batch before moving the focused row. In a mobile drawer this reveal waits until navigation is shown again. Ordinary background updates do not scroll the sidebar.

## Stable presentation and convergence
Key rows by ThreadID and group labels separately. ThreadCache owns summaries; each batch publishes once under existing title/revision rules, preserving menus, focus and running-wave continuity.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Membership and counts
Group>=2 same-thread/turn/run nodes including a tool; thinking qualifies. Preserve canonical row/call/error/preview/output order. New singleton may settle prior work without overriding inspection. Thinking moves in place; first canonical node owns DOM, loaded anchor preserves disclosure through paging/navigation. Summary and accessible names omit thinking counts; thinking stays readable inside the group. Tool failures use concise localized counts (for example, `2 failed`).

Break on prose/users/interactions/compaction/approvals/non-tool errors/Goal updates; Goal/Web Search calls remain tools. Scoped SubAgent call/report/completion/running-attention/waits join; unknown parent/other waits break. Exact uncertain tool errors join with complete-coverage unconfirmed counts; invalid success-with-uncertainty or uncertain parent lifecycle breaks. Empty placeholders transparent, unknown text proves no continuity. Answered input splits even newest settled group.

[Typed observation interruptions](flower-activity-interaction.md#observation-interruptions) retain status/grouping without visible failure counts; unknown effects keep unconfirmed counts. Exact boundaries/item/events permit counts even in partial windows. Otherwise show only localized Consecutive tool calls/accessibility name, no partial total/latest/loading. Keep known failures; counts acquire no history/body. Paging preserves disclosure/focus/selection.

Sparse islands need accepted endpoint proofs from Floret or<=8 indexed reads/explicit baseline, sharing maximal results; streaming queries none. Hidden prose/compaction/interactions/unknown/active/unsafe/scope changes break proofs. Ephemeral metadata retains surviving endpoints. Expansion fills<=40 missing items/page without tail resampling/retained retransmission.

## Disclosure and bodies
Historical group/turn defaults settle statically before display, retaining explicit choices/eligibility. Only admitted live arrivals fold before prose after row placement; folded turns skip inner placement. Choices key Runtime/thread/tool through updates/reconnect/navigation until refresh. Focus/selection/gestures/details/away-from-tail protect expansion, never reopen closed groups; only explicit disclosure/navigation reopens. Observe per group.

Live fold260ms to summary height2rem desktop/2.75rem coarse, not zero. Summary fades last100ms after140ms; new prose remains mounted/inert/invisible then reveals opacity160ms. Delivery continues; existing/inspected/historical/navigation/reduced-motion prose never waits.

Finish titles first. Terminal outer turn owns motion/nested geometry; interrupted inner fold transfers painted opacity/transform. One pending map binds later prose to owner. Reversal awaits new motion; dispose/reduced motion releases. Measure once, no per-tool timer/observer/frame reactive state.

Closed groups mount shells/summary; first open mounts bodies, subsequent folds retain inert bodies. New closed members wait; whole-turn folds retain inspected bodies. Borrow/restore existing DOM at first-node viewport with focus/selection/state. Reproject only membership/status/disclosure/order. Sealed thinking reads only explicitly open/visible through clips, observing movable displayed node. Shared two-slot read queue prioritizes interaction/cancels obsolete/reuses text. Unopened tools mount/read no bodies.

## Progressive completion
Only explicit group/enclosing-turn opening that reveals open group completes boundaries; auto-live groups never traverse history. Before paint transfer anchors/focus/detail owners when first node changes. Reopen retains latest-tools destination.

Immutable pages never overwrite newer facts/bodies; mutable IDs join bounded tail observation. Fence by thread/connection/navigation/document. Collapse cancels demand but abort-ignoring transport holds physical slot until settlement. Sample finite tail once, never chase output. Empty exhausted boundaries finish; nonadvancing fails. Slow connected reads retain demand; cancellation fences publication without releasing an unsettled physical slot. Parent receipts reuse interval events; no hidden terminal/thinking/report bodies.

## Geometry and input
Tool/thinking titles/summaries/times13px/18px. Prose/icons/summary/progress share edge; permanent gutters avoid shifts/blank titles, including children. Full-row targets put time/chevron after intrinsic text; only long text shrinks. CSS owns geometry, no text-measure loop.

One outer left native bracket/button collapses:24px target/44px coarse. Folded button covers summary/trailing chevron; stable crossfade prioritizes counts. Rail remains outside scroll body and stops before prose, no row connectors/hit-test loop. Rows2rem/2.75rem; sequence<=8rows/65% transcript; thinking<=20rem/45% window/transcript. Natural short height, thin scrollbars/localized keyboard remain.

Native scroll consumes local then chains at edges for thinking/sequences/read-only terminals/files/diffs/code. Upward wheel/touch/key pauses follow; actual bottom return resumes. Canceled/contained/zoom stays local; editors own input. Shared controller separates user/programmatic/geometry. Retain nested anchors. Explicit open positions latest tools before paint; navigation waits for row/destination. Restore static, manual folds closed. Complete counts may name latest without body read. Collapse focuses trigger; thinking retains offset/completion. [Activity motion](flower-activity-interaction.md#thinking-and-motion) coordinates arrival.

Expose viewport IDs/localized counts; folded members leave no gaps/ineligible headers. [Turn folding](flower-turn-process-disclosure.md) owns auto anchors; manual retains trigger. Both catalogs cover narrow/touch/focus/reduced-motion/forced colors.

frontmatter.title: Flower turn submission, outbox and input recall

concepts.summary: One immutable transport outbox captures ordinary submitted text and resources before asynchronous admission. Request identity survives receipt/live ordering and explicit recovery, while newer composer edits remain independent. Canonical confirmation retires transport state; recalling history never submits or restores attachments.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Submission
Core commands reject missing, duplicate, invalid or conflicting IDs; only the legacy RPC adapter may fill a missing one. [Goals](../ai/flower-goals.md) share the outbox. Empty-thread creation retains text/reference/attachment authority; first Send binds staged resources to the authorized canonical thread. Unknown effect outcomes are terminal with safe explanation and no replay action.

### Immediate send feedback
The immutable transport outbox owns submitted text, references and attachment
metadata before IndexedDB or HTTP completes. Ordinary sends render a pending
user row immediately and consume only the captured draft; newer edits stay in
the composer. Request-key message and section identities survive canonical
admission, including receipt/live ordering and prepended history. Images reserve
the same thumbnail geometry and use the authorized staged preview until admitted.
Failed and unknown outcomes retain the frozen request for explicit recovery;
server 5xx responses never prove rejection or authorize a fresh request identity.

Product admission uses published SendAck and narrow canonical summaries. HTTP
and RPC return admission identity without a post-commit history read; authorized
window observation supplies presentation separately. Agent preparation binds the
already persisted execution authority to the admitted turn. No duplicate
post-admission authority write or second conversation lifecycle is introduced.
Full model history remains an engine execution requirement, not a prerequisite
for painting the submitted message.

### Restored data and preserved inputs
New submissions capture storage generation immediately, even behind paused dispatch. Rejected input stays copyable/restorable; running it requires explicit new submission, never resumed old approvals/effects.

### Context preview presentation
One Env App `FlowerContextPreviewWindow` uses existing preview/text components for launcher and draft/canonical snapshots. Launcher owns attachment IO, sequencing and URL cleanup; Flower owns validity. Related-surface markers preserve input ownership; Escape dismisses preview before companion.

## Input recall
### Candidates and ownership
Only selected-thread canonical ordinary user messages qualify, never metadata, secrets or structured answers. [Composer references](flower-composer-references.md#reference-drafts) owns draft scope.

### Keyboard interaction
Unmodified ArrowUp in an exactly empty textarea recalls newest eligible text. Whitespace counts as a nonempty draft. Thread changes reset history browsing while retaining each draft.

### Presentation
Contextual PromptCard has no placeholder and opens with the real editor caret; ordinary conversation composers retain their localized concise placeholder. Recall restores no attachments or canonical mutations.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Composer drafts and the transport outbox own only unconfirmed browser input, stable request identity, and presentation-only launch settings. They never become authorization evidence or canonical queue, interaction, effect, turn, Thread settings, or Agent lifecycle state. Secret answers bypass the outbox, and canonical confirmation or terminal cleanup removes transport state instead of projecting a second durable command.

Recall never submits, changes canonical messages, restores attachments or overwrites a nonempty draft. Scope, availability, candidate or external-draft changes end browsing while preserving current text.

frontmatter.title: Flower turn status and process disclosure

concepts.summary: Floret owns turn outcome and timing. Terminal turns fold eligible process rows once; pending controls, uncertain effects and inspected work remain visible. Explicit choices persist, user messages/finals stay mounted, and settled question/answer receipts reopen with complete content.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Facts and eligibility
Turn kind uses the [published-module consumer contract](../ai/flower-upgrade-compatibility.md#turn-kind-consumer-contract). Host-work completion is a distinct canonical turn with no new user message; preserve its final answer, identity and timing through loading, paging and observation. Detail and live failures record safe field/reason diagnostics without rejected values or content.

Validated facts carry exact TurnID/RunID, optional control kind, start/end/outcome, work/wait/elapsed time, ordered intermediate/final IDs and complete-final boundary. Typed structure determines eligibility; summaries, prompts and time heuristics cannot trigger folds. Unknown prose stays visible.

Headers show lifecycle and total elapsed time including waits; terminal descriptions retain processing/wait durations. Show <=two nonzero units and subsecond copy. Thinking-only work keeps its own disclosure without a whole-turn toggle. Interleaved answers default open; settled question/answer receipts fold with process rows, retaining nested choices and viewport-contained decoration without folded rail/gap. Counts require complete boundaries/membership/events; otherwise omit. [Sequences](flower-tool-sequences.md) fold independently on either side.

## Ownership
From canonical admission, running/preparing/retrying/finalizing/waiting turns show a non-interactive header before provider output. Announce status politely, never elapsed ticks. Exact outcome/end enables the toggle and one automatic fold of confirmed process/intermediate rows, including latest failed/canceled/interrupted turns. Final/trailing partial output remains.

Focus, selection, gestures, open details/thinking and away-from-tail reading protect inspected work permanently against later observations. Capture an unaffected visible anchor when automatic folding starts. Explicit choices survive paging/reconnect/regrouping. Newly classified inspected rows stay until the next explicit toggle without opening siblings; only disclosure/navigation reopens groups. Retained folded bodies are inert with offsets/choices intact. Main/embedded/child views share rendering, not scroll owners.

## Placement and motion
Anchor the header after its loaded request or before the first loaded response, independently of fold membership. Keep request/header mounted during arrival. Intermediate membership spans same-turn runs; Engine owns supersession. Goals keep turn ownership; finals are run-scoped. Retained prefixes preserve confirmed facts; windows replace overlapping classification. Partial windows never fetch history for presentation. Prepending the beginning moves the header while retaining choice/focus; anchor visibility does not own disclosure.

Eligibility changes no header geometry. One-line status/time/detail slots use tabular digits, bounded widths and narrow overflow handling. Following folds align actual bottom before paint, without stale absolute offsets, synthetic trailing space or competing growth motion. Long-to-short content ends at zero with final visible. Finals remain mounted during the 260 ms fold; reduced motion is immediate. Manual/paused reading retains anchors and necessary insertion room, excluded from distance-to-latest. Input cancels follow; settlement cannot reclaim it.

Fresh visible live labels fade 0.68→1 over 180 ms; later changes 0.88→1 over 160 ms. The complete current label stays readable: no clipping, blank frames, overlapping text or character queue. Fast completion joins the active transition. One JSX text owner survives wrapper-to-button changes with node/timing intact; at most one bounded opacity animation. Accessibility, controls and geometry update immediately; ticks never restart motion. History/restoration/reconnect/urgent states/reduced motion are immediate. Hide, interaction or reduced motion settles animation.

When a turn ends while prose waits on an inner sequence, outer motion owns release and preserves nested geometry; interrupted inner folds transfer painted opacity/transform. Manual reversal retains choice/preferences. Canonical Path orders dialogue/receipts, never timestamps; preserve final segments and secret redaction.

## Elapsed time
Current-view server samples establish a browser monotonic anchor across same-turn waits/continuations. Missing sample means status-only: queue/browser wall time is not authority. Newer samples reanchor after sleep/reconnect; delayed samples cannot move live time backward. Canonical terminal time wins. Keep samples in bounded detail cache, out of summaries/wire fields/storage/events.

Only visible active headers subscribe to Surface's existing one-second clock. Offscreen/hidden/disconnected/terminal headers unsubscribe. Ticks change only the time label, never projections/counts/folding/network demand. Reconnect pauses ticking until existing transport confirmation; add no poll/request/payload/write.

## Outcome
Terminal labels use 13px/20px text and decorative 16px Floe warning/circled-stop/circled-alert for failure/cancel/interruption. Quiet color, first-row wrap alignment and localized labels preserve accessibility; diagnostics/recovery receive no duplicate outcome labels.

concepts.title: Flower working directory navigation
concepts.summary: Flower owns draft/thread directory intent; Env App destination navigation. Full-page selects/browses directory, companion omits it. Menus freeze thread/path. Activity opens Files/new Terminal; Workbench creates widgets without scaling canvas or injecting existing-shell commands.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
[Directory selection](filesystem-picker-navigation.md) owns validation; this contract owns entry points and destinations.

## Header and new-conversation entry points
The full-page header has a borderless folder/name browse button; new-conversation welcome selects the draft directory without persistent full-path secondary text. Only picker confirmation remembers a validated real directory. Browsing, cancellation, suggestions and destination navigation never write it; created-thread directories remain immutable.

The [conversation sidebar](flower-thread-sidebar.md#directory-view) can start a new draft from a listed directory. This supplies a draft-only directory override and follows normal admission validation; it does not remember a new personal default or modify an existing conversation.

## Directory and menu ownership
Right-click captures its row's thread/directory without loading, selecting or acknowledging it. Updates cannot retarget actions; handled child events cannot open outer menus. Copy/cancel restores valid triggers without scrolling.

Conversation transcript and thread-list menus expose browsing, opening a terminal, and copying the working directory. They never expose directory Favorite or Unfavorite actions; thread pinning remains a separate conversation action. Directory favorites belong to filesystem surfaces and the directory picker.

Menu actions use concise localized verbs without repeating the conversation or working-directory context: "Reference", "Copy ID", "Open folder", "Open terminal", "Copy path", "Copy", "Pin"/"Unpin", "Stop", and "Delete". The directory section retains its target path; permission explanations and deletion confirmations stay explicit. Env App and Desktop share the same labels in every shipped locale.

Directory actions retain real icons and aligned labels. Their current labels fit one line in every shipped locale; longer future labels can wrap within the menu instead of introducing horizontal scrolling. Browser visual acceptance uses the published icons and floating layer.

## Destination behavior
Activity Files reuses its singleton window/geometry; Terminal creates a new session. Workbench creates the matching widget. Request IDs, lazy loading, terminal admission and layout persistence retain ownership. Created-thread browsing includes ThreadID; menu/terminal actions require it.

## Availability and recovery
Browsing and Terminal availability are separate. Disabled reasons/errors are explicit; rejected terminal paths cannot silently fall back to Home. Existing transport, process, authorization and persistence owners remain; Flower adds no queue, lifecycle mirror or retry owner.

concepts.title: Git workspace generations, diffs and visual state

frontmatter.title: Git workspace generations, diffs and visual state

concepts.summary: Exact client capabilities and monotonic generations fence Git inventory, diffs and filesystem decoration. Dispatched effects invalidate even on unknown outcomes; preview never grants authority. Retained inspection and theme roles preserve selection and local scrolling without treating layout as content freshness.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Workspace generations
Use workspace-v1 only after the exact client confirms revision/path-status/directory-scope/stash-section capabilities. Client replacement retires old capabilities/generations and late replies. Files never uses unbounded legacy reads; Files→Workspace opens a fresh generation before section/scope.

Keep Git shell/navigation mounted with local panel loading/errors, no second curtain. Diff requests/nested file references obey JSON-only transport. One monotonic protocol `GitWorkspaceInvalidationBus` invalidates every dispatched effect in `finally`: success, application failure or unknown transport outcome; preview/validation cannot invalidate.

Filesystem navigation never waits for Git. Committed path/repository identity fences detection; old directories cannot leak facts. Bound replacement generations while preserving committed decoration. Section identity distinguishes staged/unstaged/untracked/conflicted and stash rows.

## Diff requests
Inline/Activity/Workbench/dialog share one owner. Caller patch snapshots are previews; refresh or authoritative empty/failure cannot revive them. Runtime owns first-parent meaning.

Persisted Workbench widgets store placement targets, never Git summaries. Equal target fields preserve in-flight work, patches/full context, expansion and both scroll axes across unrelated snapshots. Other inspections retain same-path fresh-summary behavior. Connection absence is not missing-file failure; successful no-file settles empty without old patches/perpetual overlay, failures retain recovery.

## Visual state
Navigation/branches/history/summaries/files use `ring`-derived interaction tokens independent of text selection. Neutral hover cannot override selection; success/warning/danger/info/remote-violet describe facts, never selection/focus.

One measured owner lays out graph rails/connectors/nodes/columns within available width without moving summaries or changing actions/selection. Workspace/commit/branch status/history/comparison reuse retained file/diff navigation; filtering/removal/section/commit changes retire stale selections. Narrow/Workbench views remain contained with independent scrolling.

Every preset has complete interaction roles. Forced colors expose selection/focus/Current-chip boundaries through system colors.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Revisions grant read consistency, never mutation authority. UI cancellation cannot prove an effect did not run; unknown outcomes still invalidate. Non-Git Flowersec outbound allocation remains outside this transport budget and cannot be claimed fixed by batching.

Layout persistence proves no content freshness. Workbench target stability cannot change inline/Activity/Stash fresh-summary semantics. Themes may vary selection hue/surfaces, never replace interaction roles with Git status colors, inherit another theme's fixed palette or use Current as selection.

concepts.title: Input focus boundaries
concepts.summary: Published Floe owns focus presentation; Redeven supplies layout, semantic state and explicit compound-input boundaries. Ordinary fields change border color only, preserving geometry/shadows; the persistent Flower chat composer keeps its border unchanged. Fix conflicting styles at their owner with source/browser checks; no fallback stylesheet.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## One visible boundary
Ordinary inputs, textareas, and native selects consume Floe's default rule. Focus never changes border width, padding, or dimensions.

Buttons, links, checkboxes, and switches retain their distinct keyboard focus indicators; buttons inside an input boundary follow the upstream compound-control treatment. Flower's lightweight permission trigger deliberately stays transparent and marks keyboard focus with a label underline instead of a filled capsule.

Flower's transcript viewport retains keyboard focus for scrolling and its context menu, but paints no outer focus outline or shadow: the clipped scroll boundary must not turn Floe's generic focus ring into a horizontal line above the composer. This exemption belongs only to the transcript viewport; its interactive descendants retain their keyboard indicators.

## Published ownership
Desktop Welcome, Env App, and Flower consume the same released Floe dependency. Product selectors may define normal and hover appearance without duplicating Floe's focus rules. Flower's persistent chat composer maps the published `--floe-input-focus-color` token to its existing field edge, keeping focus handoffs and thread switches visually quiet, including forced colors. Approval and input-request fields retain their ordinary focus behavior. It does not copy CSS rules or load the full renderer stylesheet into that document.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body: Third-party frames, separate application views, and editor-internal input carriers retain their own published integration boundaries. This presentation contract changes no IPC, persistence, authentication, or navigation authority.

concepts.summary: Published Floe owns type, controls and responsive rows; Redeven maps semantic roles without root scaling or a separate density setting. Desktop uses 13px body/control, 12px supporting and 11px captions. Coarse-pointer fields and targets retain the published touch scale.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Type roles and boundaries
Env App/Desktop bundle Inter Variable with shared script fallbacks. Guidance, errors, labels/dialogs use published roles, not ad-hoc fixed sizes or generic utilities. Root size, zoom and magnification remain user-controlled. [Message appearance](flower-message-appearance.md) owns the separate transcript reading scale.

## Controls and layout density
Inline desktop actions use 28px targets; ordinary primary actions/fields use 32px. [Settings fields](runtime-settings.md#settings-controls-and-identity) follow the same published 32px control height and `--floe-radius-field` corners rather than a product-local scale. Buttons take their height, padding, radius and type size from the published `size` primitive: `icon` for square icon actions, `md` for ordinary text actions, `lg` where a 36px target was already intended. Do not re-impose heights on top of `size`, because the merge helper lets a passed class silently defeat the primitive and neighbours diverge. Ordinary rows use 30px, with the terminal navigator retaining its documented 32px rows. Coarse pointers use 44px rows/targets, 14px body and at least 16px fields; focus changes only the existing border color.

Published group spacing comes from role tokens. Measure real published components after fonts load, recording source/package identity, font, root, DPR and zoom. Mixed-script Markdown at 434px/758px must fit within 90% of the frozen reference height. Compare matching content/dimensions; another product's screenshots do not establish CSS measurements.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body: Scale is presentation only. Composer drafts, permissions, atomic approval batches, focus handoff, and exact command copying remain defined by their canonical Flower contracts. Workbench wheel, reading selection, and floating coordinate ownership are unchanged.

concepts.title: Markdown diagram rendering
concepts.summary: Flower and file Markdown preserve authored Mermaid while consuming published Floe/Pele. External Pele renders syntax; Floe owns sanitization/scheduling/controls. Redeven binds document identity, semantic palette, locales and context without copying an alternate renderer.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
Only complete Mermaid fences become diagrams in streaming Flower Markdown. Incomplete fences remain readable and copyable code. Closing a fence creates one diagram owner; subsequent prose, terminal completion and identical snapshot regions preserve its SVG, focus and selection. Changed/removed regions dispose their owners and cancel stale results. Nested mounts inherit host Dialog placement. File previews retain their reserved viewport and release diagrams before document replacement.

Theme changes use CSS variables without reparsing or replacing SVG. Product palette maps eight published series variables to semantic graph roles. Original source stays available with explicit copy feedback, local errors and retry. Expand uses the shared accessible Dialog with zoom/fit and Escape; inline diagrams do not capture wheel input. All shipped locales explicitly supply every control label.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Lazy imports and visibility scheduling keep diagram engines out of initial assets and avoid rendering offscreen history. No Mermaid.js runtime, alternate-engine fallback, private renderer, sibling import, package link, patched Pele or copied upstream implementation. Shared fixes land in Floe and reach both hosts through a new published release.

Floe disables image loading and diagram links unless navigation is explicitly host-owned; these adapters enable neither. Final SVG and formula MathML cross the published sanitizer. Source is never rewritten to repair unsupported syntax. Failures retain the original source. Source/edge/output/queue limits bound admission, not guarantees of constant rendering time. Cancellation fences results; it cannot preempt synchronous Pele work. Measure actual browser tasks and use the explicit Flower long-thread qualification for responsiveness.

concepts.title: Page loading, asynchronous feedback and document recovery

frontmatter.title: Page loading, asynchronous feedback and document recovery

concepts.summary: Retain successful same-resource content through refresh while initial loads occupy final geometry. Source replacement and permission loss fence retained state. Published placeholders, stable controls and asset monitoring preserve work; only explicit user reload replaces an outdated document.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Page continuity
Without a successful result, retain initial presentation until authoritative data/actionable error. Keep mutation, attachment, maintenance and plugin execution progress separate from inventory loading.

Refresh preserves successful same-resource content, including empty results. Equal items retain DOM identity, focus, expansion and scroll; pagination progress stays at the end. Use existing header/action indicators, accessible out-of-flow status or geometry-neutral local overlays, never temporary rows above content.

Initial reads use structural placeholders in final geometry. Editors/previews/settings retain bounded responsive body viewports with reachable headers/close/footer. Use published Floe components/theme tokens without arbitrary delays/height animations.

Runtime/resource/source identity scopes retention. Navigation, replacement and access loss invalidate it and fence late replies. Preserve unsaved same-resource drafts; submission requires readiness/permission. Unknown Runtime status is pending, never missing installation. Canvas opening is separate from library initialization: keep the selected card until arrival. Failed file-preview requests show their requested path/retry in the same viewport, never previous-file results. Expose real progress/permission failures/errors.

- Host Applications/Web Services/Containers/Codespaces use shared frames/skeletons; [resource cache](env-resource-cache.md) owns snapshots/refresh/fencing.
- Files keeps real workspace chrome with blank regions until the directory owner admits its first valid response.
- Terminal/Monitoring use shared status until catalog/first live sample/error, retaining content on later attachment/polling. Metrics are not inventory.
- Settings/Flower/Tessiven/Plugin Center/dynamic plugins use shared module status; resource/runtime/lifecycle owners govern readiness/errors.

`ENV_PAGE_PRESENTATIONS` exhaustively covers `BuiltinActivityPage` loading/reload policies in Activity and Workbench. [Filesystem navigation](filesystem-picker-navigation.md) retains its security boundary.

## Asynchronous layout
Use published Button loading slot/`icon`; changing labels use `StableText` with every localized transient/completion/failure label. Host preparation has independently scrolling body/persistent action baseline. Unknown image dimensions use bounded 16:9 contain sizing; long diagrams/render errors scroll in reserved viewports.

## Reload geometry
HTML head installs Floe's independent `reload-placeholder` before external modules/styles. It serializes no HTML, resource text, images, inputs, URLs or permissions and invents no resource count. Shared page registry governs reload eligibility; [Activity navigation](activity-navigation-restoration.md) owns selection. Fresh authoritative data may change final layout.

## Asset recovery
Capture document ESM entry URLs with published `createDocumentAssetRecovery`; unobtrusive notice reports updated/unavailable content. Retain authenticated route and explicit user reload. Never retain old bundles, rewrite module names or serve HTML as JavaScript.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Loading stays local to page/widget; never replace unrelated mounted content, the canvas or successful results. Authentication/access loss outranks retention, which grants no permission.

Normal-state acceptance measures actual content tops, including charts and session table: stable empty feedback lanes/margins cannot pass. Validate published dependencies without aliases/overlays.

Remembered geometry conveys no resource data/authority; unavailable storage cannot block startup or hide recovery. Transport readiness proves neither current nor loadable assets. Build/import failures expose recovery without reloading over unsaved work or changing authentication/Desktop process identity.

concepts.title: Plugin Center interaction
concepts.summary: Redeven owns Plugin Center navigation; Floe owns dialogs, presence and input. Workbench uses a retained drawer and Activity the same directory page. Search/filter/selection/scroll persist. Closing management does not cancel Host execution; released ReDevPlugin owns lifecycle, permissions and surface authority.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Management placement and input
Only Plugin Center explicitly selects global Dialog placement at the product modal layer. Recent Dock or widget interactions cannot mount the drawer under `.workbench-surface`, `inert`, or a transformed canvas ancestor.

A successful Open closes management and focuses the target after canvas input becomes available; a failed Open preserves the directory and error feedback.

## Directory and responsive details
Local filters combine source (official or community) and lifecycle without rebuilding identity. Refresh status remains outside the card grid, so a pending refresh cannot appear as a duplicate card.

External installation source tabs retain three columns with the same complete accessible names when their visible selection labels need ellipsis.

## Shared design language

The directory, detail actions, package-install source form and update review compose released Floe controls. Cards use the shared default plane, without visible resting contours, decorative lift, icon magnification or custom shadow stacks. Selected cards use the shared selection fill. Shared Tags carry source/lifecycle semantics without changing Host authority.

Floe owns Input focus, Button pending/disabled treatment and Tabs keyboard/selection behavior. Search, source/lifecycle filters, retained selection and scroll remain product state. Menu triggers are single focusable boundaries with centered content, neutral hover and visible keyboard focus; nested trigger boxes are avoided. Details keep primary actions outside their scroll body, with secondary evidence in quiet disclosures.

Source tabs retain complete accessible names and three equal columns on compact dialogs. Mobile actions remain at least 44px; install progress replaces the primary action without changing card/sibling geometry. Reduced-motion, localized long copy and light/dark themes use the same shared controls.

Changing the external install source may increase body height and show scrolling. The published Floe Dialog keeps its body scrollbar gutter stable, so the panel and body widths remain fixed while the existing height transition settles; content stays scrollable.

## Plugin creation workspace

Creation opens a full product page, with an addressable draft and return path.
Creation and draft-library code load on navigation, outside the initial shell graph.
Deep links wait for the authenticated environment and plugin session before mounting
the draft reader; they do not turn connection startup into a failed draft read.
Files, Terminal, the ordinary Flower surface and Workbench retain their existing
instances while this page is active. The dedicated embedded Flower surface owns
one composer; requirements discussion and direct creation submit through it.
A new draft has one centered creation composer on a quiet canvas, without an
empty split preview. After submission the conversation occupies a compact
280–328px column and the application becomes the primary canvas. Fit and phone
width controls resize the same live iframe without moving or recreating it. Compact screens select conversation or preview through
44-pixel icon tabs within the same toolbar, with accessible names and a visible
project title. The dedicated page omits the ordinary display-mode top bar. One compact
toolbar owns preview sizes, comments, build status and
installation; permissions remain in its overflow menu. The live application fills
the remaining area without a nested header, card border or bottom tool dock.
The embedded conversation explicitly renders HTML links and fences as source;
the sandbox owns the live application. Source links still open through the host's
file action, and reference images, audio and video retain their ordinary rendering.
Other Flower conversations retain inline HTML previews.
Both the workspace and directly opened draft library use the shared Desktop drag contract and native window-control
insets; removing the outer header must not place actions under system controls.
The toolbar preserves a user-assigned draft title; otherwise it shows the
verified active preview name, falling back to the localized untitled label only
before a preview is available. This display choice does not rename stored drafts.
The compact checks action reflects actual running, failed, passed or unrun stages;
it never displays a success icon before checks have passed. Detailed output opens
on demand without adding another permanent header.

Directory cards use 13-pixel names, 12-pixel summaries, 32-pixel icons and 12-pixel
padding; selection and status do not enlarge cards or duplicate refresh content.
Drafts use a compact list with title, modified time and continuation action.

Draft creation is request-idempotent and the URL becomes durable after creation.
Unsent text and File bytes persist through the canonical authority-free composer
snapshot. Saving status follows the actual IndexedDB transaction, and leaving
waits for initial draft creation, snapshot capture and outstanding saves. Failed
creation or unavailable attachment bytes retain the page and unsent input.
Document reload/close asks for native confirmation while the latest composer
snapshot is unsaved; a completed transaction clears that protection.
A failed saved-draft read cannot display a fresh
composer or silently create a replacement. Renaming and deletion bind the current
revision; renaming an empty draft first completes its request-idempotent creation.
Deleting during creation waits for that same draft before cleanup. Restart resumes
pending admission or cleanup.

The preview is a real released sandbox surface in an isolated author Host.
Conversation resources have a local loading boundary: an asynchronous Flower read
must not detach the independent live preview through the page's loading fallback.
The first verified artifact can be applied automatically; later artifacts require
an explicit apply that respects unsaved application state. Failed builds keep the
last working preview and expose actual failure stages and bounded command output in
a keyboard-operable disclosure, including truncation notices. Installation reviews the
exact currently displayed artifact. Installation and access grants stay separate.
Each applied artifact and platform generation owns a fresh preview container,
including builds with identical package bytes. After confirmed close, an update
failure re-reads authoritative preview state before reopening; cancelling close
keeps the original surface and does not apply the artifact.
Toolbar Back, browser Back/Forward and Open installed application share the preview close confirmation
and persist the composer before navigation. A cancelled close keeps the current
surface; failed navigation reconciles and reopens a fresh preview container.
The shell leaves the draft route only after the installed target is authoritatively
present and its placement succeeds; a missing or stale target retains the draft.
A reload queries the original durable install request; it never starts another
request to guess the outcome. A committed install remains successful if inventory
refresh fails, and subsequent builds update the recorded installed instance.
After an authoritative `not_committed` outcome, Try again requests a fresh review
of the current preview instead of querying the same terminal failure forever.
Unknown outcomes retain the original request and never authorize another install.

## Canvas comments

Native right-click observations use the released upstream opt-in context-menu
callback on the same sandbox channel. Product never reads cross-origin DOM.
The selection binds the exact artifact, preview generation and current platform
frame. Normalized geometry draws a non-interactive outline and pin; a compact
selection-adjacent comment popover accepts explicit submission and clamps to the
canvas edges. Its target, text and send action form one compact editing surface. Keyboard context menus and the toolbar's
whole-preview comment provide alternatives. Closing the panel preserves text.
Compact screens retain 44-pixel comment action targets and legible input without
adding another header or permanently covering the application.
Their whole-preview comment and preview-update actions sit in the existing overflow
menu, preserving readable title space across translated labels. A pending update
marks that menu with a small dot; applying it remains an explicit choice. Selecting
the comment action opens the preview tab. Once a comment is accepted, compact
screens return to the conversation so Flower progress is visible; the live preview
remains mounted. New edits made during submission keep the comment editor open.

Comments are independent of the canonical composer and enter its existing durable
Flower outbox for the same dedicated thread. Unsent text, references and files
remain untouched. Pending or uncertain sends cannot be duplicated; normal outbox
recovery remains authoritative. Selection text is untrusted quoted context and
never grants execution authority. Source edits and builds retain normal approval;
preview application and installation remain explicit existing actions.

Only comment text is cached under the authenticated draft key. Reload, preview
replacement, navigation, resizing and subsequent application interaction require
a new selection; text survives. Submission rechecks the live frame and artifact.
Failed local persistence keeps unload protection and blocks navigation. Draft
deletion removes its composer and comment snapshots after surface closure.

## Restore saved data

Installed plugin details expose Restore saved data in the existing action menu. Discovery is read-only, including for enabled plugins. The user selects a retained record by date and instance suffix; Disable and continue is explicit when needed, and the Host then produces the exact review. A short confirmation states that current data is also retained. No permanent card, technical hash wall or automatic re-enable is added.

The dialog binds requests to the current session owner, target instance and read/write/admin permissions. Ordinary inventory refreshes preserve the review. Closing aborts reads; reopening the same target retains an uncertain plan and only checks status. Uncertain disabling likewise refreshes authoritative inventory without repeating the write. A completed recovery stays complete if list refresh fails. Source selection uses native keyboard-operable radio inputs; the existing Dialog owns isolation, dismissal and focus restoration, and mobile actions retain at least 44-pixel targets.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Draft deletion first awaits the live preview's normal close and revocation, then
removes the author workspace. A cancelled close keeps the draft and surface; a
rejected deletion restores a fresh preview only while the draft remains active.
The product must not delete its authenticated author route before SDK retirement.

Management presentation never creates a second lifecycle or permission authority. Global placement applies only to this product modal and its confirmations, not to ordinary Workbench widget dialogs or menus.

concepts.summary: All plugin sources share released package inspection, exact review and durable installation. Official/community classification changes display only. Permissions remain independent explicit decisions; unknown effects reconcile from durable receipts without replay.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Package review

Market installs automatically inspect the selected repository/release/asset and expected package/security/contract hashes. Direct installation accepts HTTPS, GitHub repository or uploaded `.redevplugin` bytes. Multi-plugin repositories expose one selection step. No plugin signature, publisher trust badge, official-only wizard or separate client protocol exists.

Updates inspect the installed original source before presenting a candidate. Changing source requires explicit consent. Same-version changed contents and downgrades are blocked in update review. Changed revision/identity or expired inspection invalidates consent. Missing or changed security evidence requires explicit review; no market preview substitutes for current Host inspection.

Lead with verified localized identity and versions. Show access changes and saved-data conversion once; collapse technical declarations, limits, hashes and source facts. Worker/storage methods imply no broad host access.

Dialogs provide scrollable content, visible actions, keyboard focus, localization, touch targets and reduced motion. Progress retains identity. Cancellation fences late replies; source edits clear repository selection and market expectations.

One concise consent confirms the exact package. Installation enables the plugin without granting permissions. Both official and community packages direct later access decisions to installed details. Surface launch targets come only from Host `action_state` and per-Surface authority; missing permission leads to permission review, never a synthetic Enable/grant sequence.

## Installation progress

The Shell observes owner-scoped durable receipts and Execution progress. First installations can be recovered without an installed inventory row. Closing Plugin Center does not cancel admitted execution. Owner changes clear observers; reconnect restores receipts. Concurrent submits share one request, and lost replies query the same request ID.

A committed receipt remains committed even if post-commit execution or inventory refresh fails. Refresh retries only reconciliation. Unknown outcomes neither replay nor erase data. Definite failure requires a new review. Retained data uses the dedicated released recovery APIs, never automatic deletion followed by install.

Both update paths close affected slots, retire authority, preserve layout and reconcile inventory through the placement coordinator. Completion offers opening only when current inventory permits it.

[Package lifecycle](../architecture/redevplugin-package-lifecycle.md) owns source and automatic-update rules. ReDevPlugin owns package validation, durable receipts, permissions and execution; UI adds no parser, receipt database, implicit grants or uncertain replay.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Discovery and surfaces
### Discovery and pinning
Activity Bar Plugins opens a Shell-root Launcher without navigation. Search intersects category with NFKC/locale-folded names, canonical keywords and explicit locale aliases. Tablet/desktop details overlay without grid reflow and restore row focus.

Tiles have one launch action, no pin overlay/indicator. Right-click/ContextMenu/Shift+F10 offers information/current-mode Activity Bar or Workbench Dock pins; pinning keeps Launcher open, dismiss restores tile focus. Plugin Center has explicit 44px touch pins; cards/details/Activity headers also offer Activity pins.

Use environment-scoped Shell preferences with independent Activity/Workbench pins and synchronized selected/accessibility state. Pins grant no launch/enable/authority. Activity unpin first completes exact retirement; failed close retains pin/error. Other windows/siblings retain lifetimes.

### Recovery, installation and policy
Authenticated session-ready invokes idempotent Host recoverEnabled without timers. Every placement consumes action_state; source classification/grants/policy/recovery cannot derive can_open. [Installation](plugin-package-review.md#installation-progress) owns durable Execution observation; [package review](plugin-package-review.md#package-review) external packages. Failure preserves placement. Plugin Center joins inventory/grants/Host requirements/policy. Method effects cannot rename capabilities; failure reloads authority/requires fresh confirmation.

### Activity pages/windows
Allocate a fresh PluginSurfaceSlot only when placement and document are visible. Hidden unopened placements retain layout without iframe/authority; close requires no open/revoke round trip. Once opening starts, hiding retains independent slot/draft/selection/undo/pending work. Visible placements may open concurrently; each actual open captures current context revision and delivers later changes once. Windows use openSurfaceInSlot. Open/bridge failure replaces iframe with local recovery; timeout offers Retry. Restart restores shortcuts but opens a built-in page.

Equivalent metadata preserves container/iframe/state; slot lifecycle owns visibility. Instance/surface/management-revision/runtime-generation changes retire leases. Cold open shows one themed accessible waiting surface, then ready or recovery/details; never rotate bootstrap labels.

Stable pinned-page component functions allow names/icons/order updates without remounting siblings or losing edits. Published Floe retained views own sibling isolation/DOM order: moving the same iframe can reload it. Acceptance checks inner document/draft and container; add no second keep-alive stack.

### Workbench and teardown
[Layout continuity](#layout-continuity) owns bindings/removal/recovery. Overlays cannot forward input, guess focus or create bridges; Workbench unpin removes only shortcut. One abort-aware FIFO dialog handles independent confirmations with initial Cancel focus. Hidden/retired/revoked surfaces cannot approve queued work; retired surfaces cannot download. Shell never uploads/retains export bytes.

## Layout continuity
Open captures display mode with independent SDK slots; neither mode creates a Plugin Center widget. `workbench/actions/open_plugin` atomically creates/reuses exact instance/surface binding. Late requests cannot lower management revision or substitute surfaces; failed cleanup retries reconciliation, never uninstall.

Containers retain identity while SDK leases retire. Committed/unknown platform outcomes invalidate slot registry first; no close after revocation. Shell reconnect owns disconnection; authenticated inventory recovery restores layout. Failed initial reads keep canvas unready/autosave off with Retry. Saved cards offer explicit reload for fresh authority, never indefinite preparation/retired-session reuse.

sections.body: Manifest kinds remain view|command|background with semantic roles; product placements are not manifest fields. Redeven never verifies packages/releases, mints tokens, serves assets, grants implicit permissions or directly calls business adapters. Retention grants no authority, platform-store inspection, reconstruction of deleted placements or unsaved plugin memory.
